I know Ross dressing rooms are never great, but I haven't encountered one that smelled so bad before.  And then it just took a long time to check out.   Not really worth it.

I love Ross! If you're the kind of person who doesn't like digging through stuff to find a deal, then go elsewhere. If you get satisfaction from getting an awesome deal on quality clothing and housewares, then Ross is for you! I found a great Guess coat here that was on clearance and I didn't see at any other Ross I've been to. I had no room in my luggage, but I bought it anyway and MADE room.  So many good deals to be had...stop paying full price for stuff you can get like half off!

The staff here are sadly lacking in customer service skills, and simple social skills. I was in town visiting when my father passed. I was in desperate need of a black suit without breaking my budget. I was elated to find a nice Calvin Klein suit for $30. I tried it on, and it was a perfect fit. At check out I encountered the rudest cashier ever. The scowl on her sour puss face was enough to scare away customers. I asked if I could have the hangers and explained I was wearing the suit to a funeral and I was trying to avoid unnecessary wrinkles. She rudely told me no while a manager arrived on the scene. I spoke with the manager and pleaded for the hangers and she said we can make an exception this one time. I was like wow, thanks! Miss Rude, and Crude cashier completes the transaction dragging the slacks all over their filthy floor to ensure my slacks would be filthy to buy. I paid with my bank card and due to my many purchases BOA put a security block on my card and the transaction was declined. The manager shouts as loud as she could DECLINED! I paid with cash and I could not believe the ignorance of the woman who was a manager. I will NEVER shop at this location again! Hey Ross clean your filthy floors, and fire the losers before you are closing all your stores due to ignorant employees.

To me Ross is kind of like a bootleg TJ Maxx. Same concept but not quite as cool. I have found some cute kids clothes there and a couple of things for my boyfriend but never really anything for me. They just don't seem to have as much inventory as a TJ Maxx. One pro is that it never seems really busy in there. It's easy to get in and out.

2013/027  I've never been to a Ross as sparsely stocked as this. Where were the narrow aisles among the clothing racks I have come to expect? The aisles were large enough to drive a small car through.  I wasn't here for clothes, but as with the other locations, they made up the majority of the sales floor.   I was here looking for a new pillow, and didn't find any goose down/feather ones. Not that I expected to. They did have lots of polyfill. I ended up buying one at Burlington and intend to come back to Ross for the cheap pillow cases.  Otherwise, the random house goods were not enough for me to stick around.

Great finds within a bit of a mess. I like the idea of treasure hunting so its fun for me. This particular Ross has a great selection of men's wear but the whole place has a slight cat pee smell - but you don't notice it shortly after entering. Definitely worth stopping in.

I have shopped at many Ross' in PA and in other states because when it comes to your clothing, shoe, purse, jewelry, home goods, bedding, and gifting needs, you won't be failed (unless your pessimistic). There's never a time I don't want or find anything I like, yet that doesn't give me a reason to shop futilely, of course. Even when you're not in the mood to shop, you don't be like "I don't want those Michael Kors' shoes" that would just defy science ha! There's always something to like at Ross. This one in particular, carries pretty much the same merchandise, so it is consistent in that matter. It's more square footage but the inventory and layout doesn't deviate. Yes, there are few things you may find here that you won't find at the other locations, but it's nothing too different. It was clean and organized, and the staff was friendly.

I don't know how I feel about this Ross..usually there's always stuff to find but this place is short-staffed and so unorganized! Things are everywhere and it's just so time consuming to scatter through them!

This store needs some help or a new manager. In the section I was shopping there were men's clothes, kids clothes, everything but the size I was looking for. Really isn't it part of the job of the store to keep it organized. I've seen other Ross stored look much better.

I'm pretty sure ALL Ross's are the same, unorganized, poor customer service, long waits, and not very good quality of clothing options. This one is no different except they did offer a better selection of cologne the most! That is the only reason I come here.

They are so rude at closing.   They had a long line during the holiday season and I was near the line, but still shopping and a lady doing go backs basically told me to leave.   I've worked at ross in San Diego and have been in sales for over ten years and that was the worst customer service I've ever seen.  Heres a tip if a custoner has a basket full of items and is still shopping let them shop, maybe your sales will increase.  She could have at least directed me politely to the register once the one cashier helped the ten other people in line.  Rude, the only reason I  gave them one star is for the prices.

UGHHHH. I really don't know what to say about this place. I have a love/hate situation...I love stores like these. Ross...TJ Maxx...Marshall's...all stress relievers for me. They're all like a treasure hunt and I love being able to take my time to try to find something AMAZING. This store has potential to be holding some gems...with that said...like, what the fuck? This store is always in shambles. There are things EVERYWHERE. I mean. If I really wanted to dig through piles of miscellaneous items to find prized items, I'd just search my room. My room is messy enough, I don't need to be searching a store also when it's supposed to be stress relieving. :( y'all need to hire some more staff...or something. Shit. The last time I was there, I was standing in line for almost 35 minutes. All because there were only two registers open. Bleh. I got an awesome painting that day though. Haha. It's the silver lining.

My name is Renea and I'm a Rossaholic.  I've been addicted for approximately three years now.  There is something about the thrill of the chase, wildly sifting through clearance items until you find that perfect pair of jeans for $8.  I used to pass this paritcular Ross every day on my way from the subway station to work and it was all I could do to not make daily visits.  I'm sure all the employees had mapped out my paydays because Ross would always be my first stop on my way home.  In comparison to other Ross stores I've been to, this one has a decently large selection particularly for being in the middle of a city.  The clearance section isn't the best I've ever seen but it's still reasonable.  On the downside, this particular Ross always has a HUGE line at every register.  I don't think I've ever waited less than 10 minutes to check out.  Prices at Ross are awesome.  Shopping at Ross has prevented me from ever being able to pay full price for clothing.  ($30 for a pair of pants, WHAT?)  I also love buying random things like dog supplies, candles, and sheets from Ross.  Just talking about it makes me want another Ross fix!!

First off, I wish I took pictures because this place was kind of a mess. The first thing you notice is the security , there were about 3 security guards and one cashier. While walking around the security guards are looking at you and make you feel really uncomfortable. On top of several security guards walking around there was not a lot of merchandise to look at. This store was all over the place and in my opinion was not an enjoyable shopping experience.  I finally got what I came for and waited in line. The line was about 10 people deep and there was only one cashier. It was not until 20 minutes later that the cashier called a 2nd cashier to help. There was more people behind me and you could tell people were annoyed with the customer service. I live around this Ross and do not remember the last time I came, and now I remember why I do not go to this Ross. I most likely will not be coming back to this store again. I would rather drive to the Warrington Ross then go to this one.  Suggestions for this store would be: have more than one cashier at the front of the store when busy. And if they are short handed a simple apology for the long wait would have been okay with me. Also organization of the merchandise would also make this store a lot better. I do not mind the security, the thing I did mind was the Security people "hawking" us ( the customers) it felt awkward and made it seem like we were all thieves.

This is another one of those "gotta hunt for it" stores, but I always leave with a great deal.  The selection of dresses they have is insanely large and this has become my go-to spot when I know I need a dress for pretty cheap.  Their shoe and bag selection is also pretty extensive and cheap.  The housewares department is definitely a lot smaller than other Ross's I've been to, but that doesn't deter me from coming here.    My only complaint, like others have mentioned, is the lines at the register.  It's always at least 6 or 7 people deep.  The cashiers try to move people as quickly as they can, but I still end up waiting way too long to check out.

Ross used to be my go-to place for kitchen ware, but recently they've downsized that area (in my humble opinion).  I was there one Sat. and it seemed that a lot of people in that section were really surprised at the lack of great stuff we were all used to seeing and buying.  However!  Their men's dept. is awesome, and I picked up three pairs of nice brand-new gorgeous dockers cotton pants for my guy - all for $14.99 or less.   They have a huge selection of jeans too.

Horrible staff from the cashiers to the "loss prevention" people. I was in a hurry one day because I wanted to stop in Ross before I picked my baby up from day care. I noticed while shopping for place mats some random dude kept walking past me so many times. Only to realize he was from lost prevention and he was following me like I was stealing. The cashiers always have an attitude. Their facial expressions scream "I hate this job and the customers". Stopped in last week and a young African American girl walked in the store right before me. Loss prevention got on his "walkie talkie" and described to someone what she was wearing.. Wtf???? I stop in occasionally for candles and other housewares but please, if you want to shop here please make sure you wear your work uniform if you can and walk at a slow steady pace or else loss prevention will come after you lol. Otherwise they will assume your poor and you steal. Oh yeah, don't make eye contact with the cashiers, they may try to harm you lol.   Ps. The bathroom, lamps, and end table sections are veryyyyyy nice! Candles are great as well.

God I hate this Ross location!!  So damn dirty and kids running around all over the place.  This is worse than a swap meet.  Then they don't even have that much clothes compared to other Ross' in town.  Make the drive to another one and avoid this location.

i am a ross ADDICT!!!!!!!! I work right across the street so i go here for EVERYTHING. the savings are INCREDIBLE!!!! the shoes and bags are my favorite things. they are all current styles and brands and incredibly marked down. i also love the home goods, baby clothes, and bath accessories.

A hot mess. Alarms going off every 30 seconds as people crossed the hall from one side of the store to the other and none of the security guards seemed to care.   While the store seemed large, there didn't feel as if there were as much to choose from as in other stand alone stores.  The store was quite messy - I get it, it's Christmas shopping time and shoppers can be nasty, but have someone at least going through and picking up all the merch that's on the floor.  The funniest moment was in the women's section when one of the shoppers shrieked, "IVANKA TRUMP?!  HELLLLLLLLLLLLLLL NO. Y'ALL NEED TO BURN THIS MUTHAF*CKING SECTION DOWN AND SEND IT BACK TO CHINA OR RUSSIA OR WHEREVER THE HELL SHE STOLE IT FROM!" and half the store clapped.

BEST dress/hat/shoe store in Philly!!! There's a female security guard who remembered me from last year when she used to work the fitting rooms! She said: "OMG! I remember you! You're that hilarious girl!!!" I liked that. P.S. This location is the FIRST stop on the Megabus coming in from NYC so it's always my first stop in Philly!

Let's face it, Ross is a messy store that you have to be in the mood to search for treasure and wait in line for.  But I'm very glad it's in Center City.  Many a time, I've had family over on short notice, and have had to run out to Ross on Market Street for towels, an air mattress, yoga mats, etc.  At some Ross stores, I can find shoes and clothes that I like, but at this one, I usually don't spend time shopping for those things bc the store is quite messy.  Plus, I have never found a cute pair of shoes in my size (women's 10) here - they're usually all rummaged through with only the very odd looking ones left.

Always find great stuff at Ross for good deals. This Ross is no different. It's pretty big compared to their average stores. There are always great brand name clothing to find for cheap prices. They sell all kinds of things from bathroom, to bedroom to kitchen items in addition to the clothes, shoes, backpacks and luggage.

This store, is usually a mess in the clothing section, for sure. I will only look through the racks if I have to waste some time. Other than that, it's kinda stressful. They do however, have a nice section of bath products and workout accessories that are easy to look through. This store is a plus if you want a discounted price. The last time I went, I had just got done shopping at the Target in the same shopping center. I wasn't about to spend $30 on a yoga mat, so to Ross I went. WHALA! I walked out with a $30 yoga mat for only $13...yes please!

I work about four blocks from Ross.  I've scored some decent deals over the years, but never any truly unique pieces.  For me, this place is strictly for work clothes.  I used to buy all manner of clothing -- but noticed that I was accumulating a large collection of a lot of cheap clothes that i only marginally liked.  You can't beat it, however, for standard issue, business casual clothing.  and work out clothes.  and towels/sheets.    so, just go and browse and see what you find.  you might be surprised.  you might leave feeling like you wasted your time.  it's all a part of the hunt, right?  i wish i could give a two-star sub-review, though, for the jewelry counter. know this, the jewelry counter is a clusterf@!&.  why?  the ross employee may only assist one customer at a time.  and you must wait and wait and wait until said customer is done looking at every ring in the case before getting any assistance.  I only keep going back to it because i scored a lovely betsey johnson sparrow necklace once.  so, despite what i know, i went to the counter last week and, lo and behold, there was a pair of tortoise shell rayban wayfarers staring at me -- for $50!  me want.  the ross employee was helping a customer and two ladies were ahead of me.  not ideal, but how long would i have to wait?  it was a disaster.  i gave up after 25 minutes.  i only held out that long because i kept thinking, "i've waited this long . . ."    i am sure they have the one customer rule for security reasons, but they seriously need to tweak that policy.    and, oh yeah, the ladies changing room ALWAYS smells like BO.  ALWAYS.

Oh my gosh! I love this Ross! They're way nicer than the ones in Arizona and Texas! They were well organized, not packed, and well stocked! Only thing that surprised me was how expensive their women's tops were.... Still nice!

I love this place for the cheapo designer clothes and household items!!! Brand names are cheap - just try and stay away from all the unknown brands because their quality may not be a high. They also have sooo much amazing kitchen ware! I found a LARGE cast iron skillet for $20! I can't bring myself to pay normal prices at other stores, now. I am spoiled on ROSS! I have to go there at least once a week or so, so see what new stuff they have. Honestly, I only find myself shopping at ROSS or thrift stores lately- why spend money at overpriced stores? Take the time to hunt and you shall receive!

BOISE, ID: Ross is the best, always easy to find treasures in here.  Today I found some jumper cables and a Swiss Army knife and push-up bars.  What will I find next time?  Only time will tell.  Great place to hunt for bargains.

BEST Ross I've ever been to! It has one huge side dedicated to women, and the other side across the hall for Men, Kids, & home decor, etc,  Constantly stocked with great deals and findings of purses, tops, and especially shoes! I love going there for comforters and pillows. I've even bought amazing prom dresses for extremely cheap prices!   The line is always crazy long, but the associates ring so fast and the one associate is the best! I never caught her name, but she always found an interest in me and everytime I saw her again, she'd always remember what I had shared with her the previous time.   Only downside is that their dressing room smells like extreme B.O., it's unbearable.

Hey babes,   Department stores (Macy's, Bloomies, etc...) get a bad rap from hardcore fashion folks. Too cookie cutter, too trendy, too blah blah. Well,  this is partly true and discount department stores (Ross, Marshall's) are their watered down counterparts. Like Red bull without the vodka... not quite as amped up.  Ross Stores are no exception to the rule, especially this one located at 7th and Market, the heart of the Gallery Mall (eek, more on that later). With Nine West castaways, imitation Harajuku bags and dresses not fit for Forever 21 windows, this store is a testament to the mantra "leave it how you found it."   Shoes and clothes alike are overflowing from the racks and strewn on the floor, sloppily. With that said, this place isn't all tacky cast-offs. Great for simple basics, comfy sweaters and an occasional winter down coat, you're guaranteed low prices... if you're into that sort of thing.  Often very busy with lunchtime traffic and downtown shoppers, get those BCBG pumps you were craving at 20 bucks, who will know... I won't tell.
One of the most disorganized and dirty stores I've ever seen. Probably a good idea to try other Ross stores and avoid this one.

whatever you do, do not go in here looking for a particular piece. you'll leave feeling tired and defeated. but if you have some time to dig through the junk (cheap, ugly, holes, stains, etc) you can find a gem or five. i have found nice calvin klein heels, a wallet, steve madden flats, underwear and a really cute michael kors wrap sweater.   the atomosphere is straight up depressing... the people that work here are miserable and have no problems cursing at each other in front of customers and i even had one of them yell at me for being in her way. the racks of clothes and shoes are totally disorganized, and the dressing rooms REEK so bad, but it's all worth it in the end when you leave with an awesome find at a ridiculous price!

I don't know why people say nasty things about this place. They offer discounted prices for nice items and they have good customer service.  In fact the store on Oracle Road is open until 1130 pm on a Monday. How can that not be good customer service ? where else are you gonna find a department store open until 11:30 PM on a Monday!
Great clothes selection. Convenient location for bus riders. I Highly recommend. At least they have some good name brand selections compared to the other one in north philly

Let me preface this by saying I've only heard of Ross before, never seen one and I'm a huge fan of TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Burlington Coat Factory et al. I'm the kind of girl that will dig through racks of clothes any day to find a great piece at an even better price.  Not here.  This place looks like a tornado went through it a few years back and they still haven't recovered.   Literally the overhead signs say "Active wear" and you find career wear, nice try.   Also as a last ditch effort I started just finding a rack and it was just like they have a woman's clothes department, with swim, outerwear, sportswear, juniors, all mixed together. I've seen Goodwills better organized, and that's no lie.   Skip it, it's a pigsty.
I love Ross period even though its a little junky its the perfect place to find a dress, nice lingerie, robe, houseware just anything for cheap...  BUT be prepared to LOOK!

This is one of the better ross stores other than the on in Oro valley, I can always find a pretty good bargain here, from clothes to shoes & jewelry, they have some really good houseware goods also; even if you're in the mood to look for something for your pet Ross has it! They also have kitchenware too.

I've been shopping at this Ross for years, and recently it seems like they've been focusing on expanding the housewares and less on women's clothes. This is ok with me, I just bought a house and need a ton of stuff. Mostly everything is hit or miss (the other day I saw an awesome ceramic parrot figurine for 1/3 of the price of ZGallerie's site), however they don't really have the same variety/caliber of items as TJ Maxx/Marshalls/Home Goods. (Oh how I desperately want a Home Goods in the city...)  Anyway, here is what Ross is GREAT for: Kitchen/dining items/serving pieces/cutlery, glasses,etc. Seriously, don't go anywhere else for say, a potato peeler, quality knives, pots & pans, baking sheets, and so on. I literally got everything to host my first Thanksgiving here, mostly Crate & Barrel-type pieces. Also: bed pillows.  Here is what Ross is GOOD for: Other decor & housewares, random accent furniture (side tables, ottomans, chairs), baskets, drapes, curtain rods, bedding, cool cleaning items. Would be great if they had a larger selection. Also: Shoes & bags, socks, tights, designer hair/body care items.  Here is what Ross is OK for if you're in a pinch: Women's clothes, esp. dresses. If you have time, though, go to Marshall's on Snyder Ave by Target.  The only thing that really bothers me about this place is how they never have bags big enough for home items or enough wrapping for breakable items. Buying pillows, heavy dishes, etc, sucks when you have to carry them home in a teeny tiny, flimsy plastic bag meant for clothes. Pleeeeease Ross, get paper shopping bags!

This Ross store is a great store for reasonable priced household items! I go there weekly and sometimes it is a mess but most times it's as neat as most other Ross Stores. I have also found the staff to be very helpful.

For real people? Is this even a store?  I've seen thrift stores with more clothing and organization than this Ross store. All the clothes and shoes are on the floors or everywhere other than where they're supposed to be. Basically people are employed to do nothing at all here.

I love Ross!Stuffs are great but staffs in toy department are rude and horrible!Having a long day at work doesn't give you enough reason to treat your customer in a rude manner!I am so sorry for some great staffs who work there but I totally forgot to get the name of the 2 rude ladies who didn't even assist me but rather raised voice on me because I asked extra freaking cheap plastic bag because they put all the toys in 1 bag and it started to reap!I will never ever go to that Ross!I will try other Ross who have hopefully well trained customer service employees!You 2 rude ladies should take a customer service orientation!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

When you think you've found all the deals, you haven't until you've check in to Ross to see what else they have to offer!!! Love this place for my fur babies, my home, my style and much more! Just can't leave this place without spotting something!

This particular location is one of my favorite's of Ross. And I will let you know why for ladies.  Not that I really want to share all of this but let me help some of you all out. First off this location for some reason has a ton of size 10 shoes--yes yes I know I Have big feet for a gal but this is the place and boom-SCORE-boots galore! Yes today I found some amazing deals on boots and it's fall and I am one happy girl!  Not only this let me share another thing go to the towel section and yep right there boom-SCORE you find amazing deals on dishtowels and washclothes.  I'm talking CHEAP and beautiful they are fantastic and yet cheaper than any other deal here in town. Now for the next thing--dresses--yep you guessed it you can find excellent dresses here and I'm talking this place is stocked full of little cute dresses that are $14.99 and less.  I'm big about finding dresses that make you feel good about yourself.  And of course you can find your size another plus.  Some stores it's hard for them to be stocked in your size not at this location And for the other SCORE--amazing section of electronic gadgets which are great for stocking stuffers. So there you go ladies---Shop on!

This was the grossest store ever. The dressing rooms were trashed question land in the bathroom smelled like it had not been clean and weeks, and the entire store was just filthy even though it was still early in the morning and there was at least 12 employees around.

Wow, this is my 2nd bad experience at this ross store right before closing.  I come In at the last minute to return a couple of things that my daughter did not wear.  It was five minutes before closing and before the security man even said hi he tells me they are closed.   I asked him if they closed at 10:30 he said yea I look at my cell and it was not 10:30.  I did not plan to shop and I had my receipt so  it would have taken two minutes to help me.  This Is the  worst ross ever.  Unacceptable customer service,  here's a tip to corporate get your staff some customer service training.  I spend at least $100 every payday at this store, over 2k a year. Seriously annoyed!

I walked in and the store was a mess, the check out lines were long, and an employee was talking about quitting. The quality of clothes seem less compared to other Ross stores around middle Tennessee. I usually shop at Ross but will not return to this particular one.

This store is just a hot mess.  I don't think there's a single area of the store that doesn't look like a tornado has torn through it.  Items are all over, including on the floor.  And as a result, items look disheveled and beat up.  I really wouldn't buy many items from here because they're just not well taken care of.  I get that the stuff is priced very inexpensively, but I still respect the things that I buy and would not treat them in such a way, regardless of cost.  My opinion is not popular here, clearly.    And the parking lot is a horrendous zoo.  People will park within an inch of your car door and not give it a single thought.  I drive through more than I park because I go to Michaels in the same shopping center all the time, and people pull out and drive like overall morons in this area, too.  I have no idea what's with the Ross customer base, it must be the low prices on defective items rotting their brains so much that they forget how to drive safely.  There are other Ross locations in town that aren't quite as hideous all around.

I got a $7 pair of sunglasses here that were originally $60, so I would consider that a win! I did not have enough patience to sort through the racks and racks of clothes though. They had a surprisingly decent shoe and handbag selection, too. If I had to choose between Ross, Marshalls and Century 21, Ross would be the last on my list due to the general lack of organization to the store. But if you are willing to put in the time, you will get some deals!

Worst customer service ever! They have two lines, one for returns the other for purchases. I stood in the return line waiting for customer after customer who came in after me to buy their things when I had ONE ITEM TO RETURN. It would've taken less time to just do the return than to have me WAIT THERE. It was one item I was returning, not like I had bags full of stuff I didn't want, AND it was a sun shade that didn't even fit my car. I like coming here for the low prices but customer service really needs some work
Lots of variety in clothes and shoes. Their plus size section was much better than most.
The worst Ross I've ever been in. Dirty, disorganized, low inventory, only one cashier with 9 people waiting in line.

Lately, this Ross has not had a great stock, the store itself has been dirty and unorganized and it feels as if those who work there don't care about appearance - for their store or themselves. There are some wonderful associates there who do go above and beyond to provide excellent customer service, including the security at the front, but ... there is security at the front due to shoplifters and many associates are usually cranky and have an "I don't want to be here" attitude.
Can always find a gem or two if I dig through the racks but holy hell do you wait forever in line. They are forever understaffed at the registers. Management should be ashamed!

This location of Ross was a pretty good one. Some of the clothing was out of place, so I moved a few items to the end of the racks to be replaced. I found a fantastic work dress and a beautiful top to bring home to North Carolina. Overall, I enjoyed my shopping experience.

The store is a mess! They had dirty clothes, I'm taking pink baby outfits covered in black grime hanging on racks to be sold.  When we did finally find a couple good items for a friends baby shower, we head to the register and get behind next person in line. When they leave my daughter starts to put the stuff on the counter. The cashier walks away and then goes over to her co worker hangs out for a bit and then comes by the reg again and turns off the light and walks away never to return. At which point the returns lady calls the person behind us up and starts ringing them up. Not one word said to me during this entire 10 min thing. I dropped the stuff and took my daughter crying out of the store trying to explain to her why we were not getting her toy.  I was half tempted to walk out with the stuff that I was trying to buy! I will never be visiting this store again! Wow!

We were in a bind and needed some quick items for our trip...although 13 miles away, we know Ross and made the hike.  Great location and great selection.  Doesn't disappoint  Inventory was low, but it's the holidays...

I just like shopping at ross ;) Live like queen at my budget price ;) Good fashion friend  Nice ffiendly staff  Always have new shipments  For the whole family need  Smart business idea ;) MNy stores nearby

Ross is always a great place to find deals, and Hendersonville has great stuff. I never had an issue, and been pretty much welcomed.   Only one time I definitely did not appreciate: The cashier didn't bag all my stuff and went to break right after so I assume she wanted to get it done and over with, and when I noticed when I got home(since we had A LOT of stuff), I called.   They could not find it, and said they would look at the security cameras to see if we actually had those items and I wouldn't hear anything for like 2 days. I told them what it was IN DETAIL, like to the bit. Then they found it and I went to pick it up.   When I came in, they basically acted like I was a criminal stealing 2 7.99 things. The cashier was right next to me & the security talking, and didn't acknowledge anything that was said or apologized. Or even said "yes, I forgot to put it in the bag and they were here." I know she heard us, like I said, we were RIGHT next to her.   I understand precautions but I mean come on. I was there literally an hour ago from when I came in. I just didn't like how they handled the situation at all. Otherwise great store and deals. :)

It's absolutely the place to go if you need a spatula, some old Paula Dean branded whisks, oddly shaped glass containers, a flagon, a 1-armed hello kitty with fingerprints embedded in the plastic, oddly very decent plates, a small screaming Armenian child, one shoe in your size, spaghetti, clothes that are alternately expensive, or not so much that look like they should be at a 1980's garage sale.  You can find designer knock-off colognes, plastic knives, lobster bibs, scarves, a depressed 28 year old man wondering why his girlfriend is going through a pile of garbage, misplaced clothes by the sack full, long lines, people arguing over prices to return things, and a security guard or two.  I've got to say, I find this place interesting in the way I find museums interesting "why would someone invent such a thing?". There's a lack of cohesiveness however that makes it not so much a store as a garage where things were priced by someone who didn't quite know the value.  I think the place used to be significantly better, but my time in it over the years it's degraded significantly. I realize it's a dumping ground for overstocked items, but it looks like the last days of a going out of business sale pretty much constantly.  Don't buy anything there you haven't tried on. If you do, imagine your salary, imagine how much of it you'll be flushing in a 20-30 minute wait for 3 people in front of you. There's never a time I've been there where there wasn't a line and a pileup caused, usually, by one of their customers.  Add to this the insanity of the parking lot, and you've got a place that's sort of on my not-visit list... or at least park as far away as is possible.

[798]  This Ross Department store is located near the Jefferson Station (SEPTA's old Market St station).  The store is big so it's on two sides of the mall.  The kids on one side and the adults on the other.     Staff is very friendly and helpful.  We found tons of specials in the dress, active wear and shoe department.      We will definitely be back.

I'm a fairy godshopper on my days off.  I found a very anthropologie looking table here yesterday,  a pair of pj pants for a picky cantankerous soul, and a replacement wallet for my friend that had her most favorite wallet of her lifetime stolen at distrito.   You feel like digging, this is the place. You need help finding the perfect LBD to wear to a wedding......don't ask the ladies for help here, this ain't macy's.
Store is dirty, disorganized. Poor customer service as well. Cashier rude to me. I won't go into detail but the other reviewers are correct. Manager unimpressive and unhelpful as well

I usually shop here and i like it. But the reason why i gave them 1 star because of the cashier attitude, we just asked her for a bigger bag so it's easier for us to carry since we had to walk many blocks to get to train station. she rejected and explained in a bad manner that the bag only for customer who buy a lot of stuff and gave us a mean look. I just don't understand why she is so stingy just for a bag. We will never come back here again

I'm shocked to know that anyone has a good experience in this store.  It's filthy all the way through (dressing rooms included) so I don't advise trying anything on there. It's also completely disorganized and hard to navigate as the clothing is just thrown up on racks.  Pass.

Absolutely the rudest employees in TN. They bark orders at you and treat you like you're an inmate in a prison. "Place the clothes on this rack. Count them." (Dressing room) "Remove the hangers. It says that on the sign there." (Cashier) I guess customers are expected to do the work for the clerks who have zero personality and are just barely there. This is the place to go for a lesson on what not to do in retail. Don't expect a greeting, smile, thank you or any courtesy. You're an unwanted bother. Will never go back. Our visit was Monday January 13 between 3:30 and 4 PM.

It's the average Ross store. It's divided into 2 sections spanning the first level of the market place building. Security guards are viable, but they let you roam from side to side without any  problem.
If you like waiting in line behind 10 other customers, with only one cashier , this is your store!
No No No No! this store is constantly a mess!  Unfriendly associates and very poor selection.  I won't be back!  The store smells awful too!

The cashier would not return my clothes. There was a long line and only 1 cashier. This store has only 2 stars and I can see why. The customer service is terrible. I will be shopping at Burlington from now on. Do not shop here!!

Ok, yes, this store is gross. Unfortunately many discount stores, such as this one, are filthy. With that said, I had a clothing emergency (am I the only one who has serious trouble finding a strapless bra that doesn't end up sliding down around my waist?!?) and HAD to find a bra that would actually do what it was supposed to do...support the twins.      Not only did I find one to suffice for the time being, but I also bagged a great deal on a super cute Calvin Klein dress. ^awesome^     But, I didn't stop there. My other finds included some workout wear, and several cool, 'just had to have' items for my precious pooch!     BTW, be careful of the woman working the dressing rooms! She reminded me a bit of the soup nazi from Seinfeld. Scary.

So I was going to changing room that woman standing there was little he obsessed with me just to go win, When I came out Pasco what I can for the rest of the clothes that I don't want to like just hang them back and handed over to me ,  So she had no manners and she was supper aggressive
I bought a jacket cause winter is near from this ross! But be ALERT!!! BED BUGS! BED BUGS! I found a bed bug on the jacket!

Our visit on 2/20/2021 was one of those "hit or miss" shopping experiences. We found a few items worth purchasing. The majority of the available selections were just not the stuff that we were looking for. But don't worry, we will definitely be back another time.

Let's not pretend that Ross is trying to be something it's not, because frankly that would be ironic and hilarious. Let us instead focus on what Ross does not do well in comparison to other retail shops in the area. At no point were there more than two cashiers despite the day or the hour (yes even big holiday shopping weekends). The store itself was dirty, things were not properly stored or arranged, team members were frantically being chased around the aisles while there were more than twenty customers waiting to check out. The narrative that a loss prevention specialist needs to stand around while the store burns down is also very questionable. I think that there must be some deep flaw in the way Ross continues to operate all of its stores and continues to think that this is okay. At the end of the day, the service/experience must be tolerable or the clothing/product selection and pricing must be adequate. Ross is neither, and the fact that everyone accepts this and lowers their expectations accordingly tells you all you need to know.

I went into the store not looking for anything in particular. I was not greeted at all. One of the employees almost walked right into me without saying anything like 'hey didn't see you there', 'sorry', 'get out of my way'. As a store that depends on customers, it might be wise to have good customer service.  Another incident (same guy if I am not mistaken) happened when I was near the chair section. Yet again nearly runs me over. I see "Loss Prevention" on his vest and I get it. The job is demanding especially in a store that is so disorganized.  One of the best things for Loss Prevention to do is make sure things are in their place. Then you will be aware if something is out of place.  I do not go into places wanting to serve but I had to report that no one in the store appeared to have any type of customer service training. I could compared it to my Cracker Barrel experience barely 20 minutes prior. I held a complete conversation with one of the ladies in the store and wanted to support company because of her. Cracker Barrel's main focus is food and they still had better customer service in their clothing department than Ross. Please get it together Ross!

My favorite ROSS in town by far! I never have any issues at this location. Always has a fairly decent selection of items in all departments. Employees are generally helpful and curteous. Fitting rooms are clean and well monitored. This location is open until 11p.m. most nights which is super cool! Thank you!

This is the worst shopping experience I have ever had. My mother had returned a present she got back in November 3 days after she got it, they gave a refund receipt. She has went every week looking for the item in her size to no avail. So she let me go pick out some clothing.  We get to the register after waiting 25-29 mins. To a rude cashier who never smiled and got rude with me and my mother. Never apologized about any of it and treated us like liars. I told her this practice was like theft and she proceeded to tell me it wasn't since we returned the item, I said if we don't get a replacement and you got the item then that's technically theft. The girl was beyond inept, I've never seen such horrible customer service skills besides that of a stereotypical Walmart or McDonald's worker. We called the 1800 number on the back and the lady got everything fixed for us. The assistant store manager acted nice when we came back, I will never do business at this location again.
Came to Ross and there's never cashier people only one person and they don't even have manners.....
this store is constantly a mess!  Unfriendly associates and very poor selection.  I won't be back

I really love shopping at Ross, but often find myself questioning their decisions when it comes to their stock, since some of them offer an unusually small selection of clothing for men in favor of women. Thankfully, this location had a nice balance.   Coming to this location on a busy weekend afternoon, I expected to find it in disarray, and it was. I'm not sure if it has more to do with the patrons who come here, or the staff, but it is almost always in disarray at this time of week. I do not usually encounter the same issue at Kohls or Marshalls.    So when it comes down to it, this is really a typical Ross location now that I think about it. Except, the selection of men's clothing is among the best I have ever seen.

TODAY YOU PAY!  BWAHAHAHAHAHA!  It was approximately one week ago that I discovered that my local Ross store had somehow deleted my personal, photos in favor of their own corporate glossies.  How sweet.  NOT!  Although my photos were unfavorable, at least they were accurate and honest.  The corporate photos were not even close to resembling the actual store.  So fast forward to this week and guess what?  Karma comes a-knocking because I visited this Ross in an entirely different state and I found  the same mess that Ross does not want photographed and posted.  Well, too bad!!    If you don't want this mess posted, then change it by hiring enough people to handle the problem.  Also, If you want customers to respect your store, you must first respect yourself and adopt policies and procedures that show you care.    I must say that this store was over-the- top messy and the photos speak for themselves.  Enjoy!  ***Check-out was quick and easy as this area was adequately staffed.

Might take some time (and patience), but you might find a bargain piece, and an even greater deal on clearance! Fitting rooms are well kept, staff seems friendly and there are plenty of food options & a nearby theater for this who want to pass time elsewhere as you go on a treasure hunt.

This is one of the worst Ross's I've been too! Walking in I could feel how stuffy it was, maybe too many people that the air quality was suffering. We went on a Saturday afternoon, the place was packed. It seems people just don't care, it was such a mess there. Despite the number of people in the store they only had 2 cash registers open, the line ran around to the back of the store. I felt bad for the 2 cashiers who were working as fast as they could.  We saw the line and the crowd and decided to drive to another Ross vowing never to return to this one.   Parking there was ample although very narrow.   Overall, there are other Ross's to patronize that have better ventilation and not so messy.

Horrible customer service. I'm a foster parent so I often have to use vouchers for kids that move in with me. This means I have no idea what size they should be wearing so not taking them isn't an option and they usually come with nothing so I have to take them shopping right after they've met me, when they're going through a traumatizing time. I had staff announce, loudly and repeatedly that they were doing a "foster kid" voucher which humiliated my 15 year old, they refused to let me take a cart into the dressing room because it was a "safety issue" so instead of my kids being able to sit safely in the cart I had to wrangle 2,3 & 4 year old boys while helping my 14 yo get school clothes. On one occasion the guy incorrectly rang the order so he had to return the whole thing and re ring everything up, with the "help" of the manager who had to call someone to walk them through it and the whole process took approx 30 mins, this after we stood in line for almost 10 mins. So rude and poorly trained.

As far as bargain clothing shopping goes outside of thrift stores, it doesn't get much better than Ross.  Ross is one of those quirky department stores that I didn't even realize existed until I read an early Mayor Jim Kenney Interview where he sang its praise. But since then I've known to go there to scope just about every clothing and houseware retail item imaginable on sale. Because while they predominately deal with men's and women's clothing; you'll also find discounted bedding, bathroom supplies, shoes, perfume & cologne, and then some.  The catch 22 caveat is that the bulk of the product is deemed unsuitable for regular retail for whatever reason. It might be because the item is out of season, the brand might have since released another newer version, or the packaging is too banged up. But despite that you still walk out with plenty of name brand designer items, and end up paying significantly less. And for that its well worth dealing with things like the off condition, wonky hours, and weird store placement.

Ross is good for designer clothes at reasonable prices.  However, when it comes to trends, they could use more which is an honest review.  Sometimes you may have to play Sherlock Holmes to find the designs that you want from this store.  They have alot of apparel where you can mix and match your outfits. As far as the shoes, I'm a size 10 so they are always sold out of the style I am willing to get.  I have to order online.  If you are looking to do quick shopping and have reasonable savings, Ross is a good place to shop.  However, beware of the lines as they can get very lengthy and the best time to shop at any place is in the morning.

Good deals. Various available items at great prices. It's always good to stop in & see what new merchandise is in stock for purchase. We love that it's not the overwhelming expieriences like the malls or other outlets stores.

Ross is good for gifts, home decor and knick knacks. This location is huge and I have shopped here to decorate my apartment and buy Christmas gift for great prices. It is not meant to be fancy or anything. One purchase in particular that I am happy with is this excellent coat for my little cousin. She is 4 and I bought this amazingly warm and stylish coat for 13 dollars! I also bought these really nifty bookends for 6 dollars a piece. Love it.

This is one of the nicest Ross locations that there is. I understand that's not saying much but this location has staff members that are friendly, can speak English and the store itself is extremely clean.   It's one of the newer locations so we will have to see how long that lasts but my few visits here are always better than the Citrus Park and Town n Country stores.   This store is large and has a nice amount of inventory. They keep the store very clean and unlike other stores, you can actually move in between racks.   The checkout process here is very fast compared to other locations and overall is a much better shopping experience.

Have not been in this store for a while. Went last evening. It was a dump!  Merchandise and trashe literally strewn about the store and in the floor!  It looked like a war zone!  Half of the store was empty. Disgusting. Too bad
Set up nice but the selection isn't very diverse. It's good for clothes and housewares but everything else is lacking, especially bedding

I love Ross...I'm addicted to this place. Cheap prices and cheap (but cute and wearable) clothing and home goods. This is a newer location, a bit smaller than the ones I am used to. It was clean but very disorganized...the majority of the garments I picked up were a completely different size than what was marked on the hanger. It was very frustrating and I ended up not buying anything...at this location. There is one a few miles from here on N. Missouri that is much more organized and seemed to be better stocked.

To keep the main idea short and sweet, this Ross has damn near nothing in the store. The lack of clothes makes me laugh because it's a clothing store for Christ sakes. The racks are so barren but I must say that although there's a lack of items the prices for the things they do have are low. Don't go in here expecting to find a head to toe complete outfit. In addition to the barren racks they only had two cashiers on the registers. That might be ok for a weekday but definitely not on the weekend when there is a line that stretches into the juniors clothing section. Not only is it unfair to the customers but it's also unfair to those poor cashiers that had to handle the load by theirselves. There was only one other associate I saw in the store and she was working the dressing room and seemed a bit unhappy. It was so bad that a lady behind me in line called the manager on her phone, I attached a video of the line. This Ross isn't one the worst but it could be greatly improved, starting with having more associates and clothes on the floor.

I like Ross. You can always find great deals on a wide array of stuff, whether it is clothes, shoes, purses, house stuff, doggie stuff etc. This location is okay. There's also one nearby in Wesley chapel in the grove. When I am in the area, I will definitely go here. Given the fact that I live here in the sunshine state, this is our go to place to get cheap nice somewhat sturdy sunglasses. If you don't find also ny thing at ross, check out the other stores in this same shopping plaza including bed, bath, & beyond, Joanne Fabrics, Petsmart, Dollar tree, BJ's, just to name also name a few.

As far as the choices of Ross stores in the area, this one is much better than the one in the University Plaza. It is in a nice location, along with Jo Anns, Pets Mart, BJ's, and a few others. I have always liked Ross for the prices, because they are cheaper than Marshalls. However, the selection is not usually great. I wish they would get more inventory.
Lots of selections and very reasonably priced.

Nice, clean new Ross. So spanking new in fact that it's a bit bare in the sale department.  Got here half hour after opening,  and walked out empty handed. Still preferring the store layout of the Hillsborough and Citrus Park stores.  The checkout lanes were buzzing with confused seniors, and the specialty foods were next to the registers,  not in the back next to cooking tools. Still, certain it will do just fine next to a buzzing Aldi supermarket opening tomorrow!

I actually had higher expectations of this Ross dress for less because it is located in Carrollwood. It was a lot worse than the one in my neighborhood and I was sorely disappointed.   They have basically the same items as many of their stores however there was less of everything! In addition, the floors were pretty dirty and there were gaps everywhere. I'm not sure if it's because they have limited merchandise but it looks pretty empty in there and it doesn't look like they were going to refill it anytime soon because this is not my first visit here.  I think the main thing that bothered me was that they need to tidy up the store a little bit and maybe wash the floors.

This is your above average location due to the fact that items aren't all over the ground and the store is actually neat and organized, unlike most Ross locations.   The store is clean, spacious and is well spread out along with aisles that aren't bunched together. You can actually walk in between them without clothes rubbing up against you. The apparel selection is average and the prices are exactly what you would expect.    During my visit the store was not very crowded, which made this experience quick and easy.
Why all the haters? I think this is one of the better Ross stores in the area.  I never leave empty handed, unfortunately I usually buy more than I intended to.  That's why I'm only giving 4 stars :)

I've never been a fan of Ross and this store didn't change my perception.   Now I love Marshall's and TJ Maxx, but Ross just seems "dirty" to me.  The selection is mediocre at best.    Since this location recently opened 5 minutes from my house, we figured we would pop our heads in one night and take a look.  The store seemed pretty sparse and lacking any decent inventory.  Yes, it's clean, but it's brand new...give it time and the racks will be unorganized and half the clothes will be on the ground.  I see no reason why I would return to this location.

3 stars because it's hit or miss. Some days I come in and find amazing steals, other days I feel like I'm shopping at a flea market. Today my search was for an upgrade of my workout clothes and Ross came through with a couple great buys. I will continue to shop here because I like the thrill of intermittent reinforcement, kind of like playing the lottery lol.

Out of all of the rosses that I've been to this one is the worst. I never find anything the customer service is just ok, It's definitely nothing to write home about. The store always seem like it's having going-out-of-business sale. Buy going out of business I mean  the store is basically empty .  I would recommend going to other rosses the area that have a better selection.

was visiting tampa looking for apartments when i received notice that i had a last minute-scheduled interview. went to ross, and for $90, i got a nice buttondown shirt, khakis, a tie, and shoes that helped me get the job!

This is the first bad review I've  ever written.  I went to the new Ross on East Bay Dr., and I have to say not much to choose from in clothes.  One register was busy, so a girl took me on another register.  No smiles from this girl, and when she talked to you, it was brief and to the point!  I told her she was very rude, and she pushed my bag to me and sarcastically said "Have a nice day".  She may have been a manager there I'm not sure, but I will never go back there again!

This place is in an awesome location. You actually might miss it if you don't look up. It's a little bit hidden, but the location is awesome because it's right next to a major road and the highway. You find great deals for your home and for clothing. We bought some awesome sunglasses for my wife. She love them and they were such a great deal.

Ross stores are always a bit of a nightmare to me.  The clientele is usually one step above those at a flea market or at a thrift store.  They just sort of feverishly rummage thru the clothing racks looking for deals and haphazardly toss shit on the floors or put items back where they don't belong. Oh and then there is the fact that a "loss prevention" security guard is needed, and in plain sight.    Thankfully, this Ross is brand-spankin' new, and located in a quiet bay-side city and free of your run-of-the-mill Ross riff-raff.  This store is clean, orderly, well-organized, well-stocked and the staff is a pleasure to deal with.

Where is everything in this store?  It's so empty. Selection, options, what's that?  Not here. I know it's a newer store, but still. I would hope you would have more stuff soon.  I do want to buy something. I love to browse around, look for fun stuff - shoes, purses, clothes, house stuff. But, I can't seem to find anything good here.  I go here when I am in the area. Next door is a new Aldi, so I am usually at Ross, Aldi, and the dog store. Hope this store fills up soon. I can always find good deals at Ross, so let's go. Fill up your store.

As with any discount store, the selection is hit or miss.   I scored a lightweight pair of shorts in my unusual size (26W/50"), pockety enough to not carry a bag at Disney World, for about five bucks. But I found no navy dress pants, which is what I'd come looking for.  The fitting rooms' security was a pain in the ass. The TSA agent wouldn't or couldn't count my (two) items when I held them out in my hand. She told me the items had to be placed on the rack, and when I handed them to her so that they could be placed on the rack (which was in front of her, but out of arm's reach for me), she seemed annoyed that she had to put them on the rack "for" me.   Later, when I went out to show and tell, there was someone else working the TSA line by the time I returned, and this one wanted me to put my own shorts on the rack to be counted. I breezed past her while explaining that I already WAS trying something on, and got the hell out of there before she decided to take me prisoner for malcountage.  Next time I see something I might want to buy here, I'm going to be tempted to just strip down in the aisle to try it on.

The Newest Ross in the local area, it tends to be the best kept. They have a good selection of shoes, of hair acxessories, of purses and dresses. Their tech selection is ..ok, but of course it's Ross, not best buy or tiger direct.  They have a nice selection of dresses, Wether it be for everyday use or special occasion. Give them a look see.

I now remember the reason why I never liked shopping at Ross. I don't know what gave me the impression that the experience would be different. Unfortunately, I was wrong. The selection of clothes were bare. The only reason Ross is getting two stars from me is because of their home good selection. Ironically, they have a great selection for dirt cheap. If, and I mean if I ever go to Ross again it would only be for the home goods. Ross should really consider revamping their stores. I'm surprised that they're still in business. Perhaps it was just this location? For their sake I hope it was.

Just moved to the area and I am pleasantly surprised that this Ross is open until 12am. AWEWOME sauce! The store is well organized and the place is clean compared to other Ross locations. Will be back again and again!

Entering Ross there  was trash literally over flowing from there yeah can outside!  Parking seems limited and farther away than usual.  Hit up sunglasses first which had a nice selection.  I like that I can get names like Kenneth Cole, Guess on the cheap like 5.99 to 9.99.  In this place you have to be patient, but you can find treasures.  There were lots of merchandise missing especially in the cosmetic area, looked like someone's would just snag a brush or make up from the packaging  A woman was working on cleaning up various areas in the store which madder it much easier to shop.  People seem to throw items around and not put them back.  Found a few cute shirts for my daughter!  I always love their hair assessories section and they always have a few adorable Betsey Johnson purses!  Go when you're not in a rush, find some treasures

What a flipping horrid Ross.   1 ... yes 1 row of plus sized clothes. That's two sides to one rack, less than just about anywhere else in the area. Totally unorganized, the store was dirty, and in general, for as large as it is, it has very little merchandise to hold. It feels like a werehouse.

For a newer Ross - this particular store opened in October, it sure is ... well, Meh.  Yes, it's bright, but that's where the niceness ends. The stock is minimal, they have one cashier on duty - and according to her, that's pretty much status quo.    Accessories and make up were NIL, the absolute minimun that I've seen. The fashions were pretty pathetic too. About 3 racks of regular, 1.5 of plus & petite combined and too many of Juniors.  The Dress racks were all discombobulated with the sizes all jumbled together. It makes me wonder if people spend time doing this on purpose or if it's just something that the staff doesn't pay attention to when they're putting clothing back.  Meh, I'd hoped to find somthing exciting. Alas, I did not.

This Ross is located in a little shopping center with other stores such as Bed, bath, and beyond, BJs, Petsmart, Joann's Fabric, and more. This store is really a hit or miss. Sometimes you find something and sometimes you don't. I like to look at the home and kitchen section because they sell things at a decent price. I like coming to this location since it's not too far from my house, but lately the shelves and racks been pretty empty.
Friendly staff and very quick lines. Clean store and awesome clothes options. Never hectic- calm atmosphere.

I like that this is such a CLEAN Ross. I've seen some that look like a tornado ran through it but this one is constantly being taken care of immediately! Good job Ross workers!   We are always so happily greeted when we walk in or thru the store. I'll admit it's hit or miss on stuff but a bargain is always a bargain no matter what!   They have a big parking lot and there are lots of other shop and restaurants around it so that you can build up an appetite.
Used to have a ton of quality selection, has now gone completely downhill :( Store used to be immaculate, but no more.

Wow! Horrible service receives by Sonya! I asked if there was a return line and she told me "NO" that it was the same line for everything after I've been waiting in line for 20 minutes someone walks by her (im sure a relative or friend) and she takes him!!! I asked once more "I thought there wasn't a return line? " and her response was "oh well someone told him to stand there". When it was my turn to pay I asked her what was the address of the store and she completely ignored me and when I kept asking she said "I don't know" wow! You have no clue where you work.... that's very mature. I asked for the manager who happened to come give her an override and I said I needed to submit a complaint and she points at the sign where it says her name and says sure call and submit it.  I mean these people should just not have jobs and go be miserable.
Store is brand new so nice and clean as the time goes I expect bigger selections but you can't beat the prices

I've been shopping at this Ross for years and tonight I had such a horrible experience I am probably never going back. I went into Ross and I was looking around in the clothing section and I went over to the active wear and when I walked away some older lady that was an employee went over to where I was at and was mumbling under her breath curse words in Russian. I didn't mess up the clothes I just simply skimmed through them. So a BIG FUCK YOU to that lady and if I knew your name I would of been glad to call you out if you can't handle your job then you shouldn't be working there.

Walk Walked in got attacked by sales staff and security because I had a drink in my hand ridiculous you guys are dress for less let's not forget it. Go easy on your customers you're not selling high end stuff. Ridiculous policy since half of the merchandise is on the floor.

I can't resist stopping here first for bargains. Lots of name brand stuff at heavily discounted prices. The Oro Valley store is cleaner and less cluttered than other Ross stores I have been to. As others have said, I agree the staff is friendly and the lines are never long. The available selection isn't always great.

Came here for a few house items and I was shocked at the disorganization. There where aisles where items where all over the ground and it was an absolute mess!!!! There was only one person working at the cash register and the wait line was extremely long. I will try and avoid this location from now on!

This Ross is always clean and has very few people. The manager is so nice and friendly and very helpful. I enjoy coming here because it's on a great street and close to home. I appreciate how clean they keep it and I like how they have a great close selection. They also keep up with all the seasons and offer a great selection for decorative material for the home as well as for the kitchen. I always come here when I need something new.
The manager closed the dressing room. A clothes store without a dressing room - seriously?

Ross is really a hit-or-miss kind of place.  However, I must say, the Oro Valley location is more "hit' than "miss".  The store is almost always clean and organized compared to some other local Ross stores (ie Tucson mall area). The staff is very friendly and the customers are too!  Like most Oro Valley businesses, customers are more plentiful during snowbird season.  I've been very happy with my bargain steals on shoes, dresses, and kitchenware.

We haven't been to this particular store and location for a couple years, and as I was in the neighborhood running errands, I thought I'd pop in to see if they had any Valentines decorations (they typically have a lot of seasonal items).  When I walked in, I got the immediate sense that I was going to be disappointed...the store looked pretty bare.  Unlike the TJ Maxx in South Tampa which is packed with all kinds of good stuff - from the moment you walk in the door - this variety and volume of merchandise here was so sparse that I wondered if they were even open?  I finally found the seasonal "aisle" (I should have snapped a photo!), which consisted of 1 small, anemic stand with about 5 cheap "Valentines" themed items: makeup and such with a heart theme.  Wow.  Too bad, as this store used to be a regular draw for us when in the area.

The lady at the dressing rooms was not there she continued to walk away. She was kinda rude and told me she was tired and didn't care. The swimsuit pieces are out together so I couldn't try them on. I got one thing I like but very disorganized wrong sizes and the the signs for swimwear,active wear, etc. aren't I'm the right places.

I brought in my service animal and I was told that if I wanted to shop there I would have to put her in a cart. There is no way I can lift my 70 lbs golden retriever into a cart. Disappointing that my service dog was denied and that I couldn't even go 5ft farther than the door.

I don't enjoy hunting for buried treasure - which is how I feel when I go to Ross - but in the end it can be worth it. Most of what I see in a Ross is something that will end up in my yard sale pile six months later, but quite often I find incredibly great bargains...and I just love bargains.   This requires frequent trips, sometimes several times a week, and sometimes to multiple stores. I'll be on the hunt for specific style or color dress, but before I find that one item I often end up going home with two dozen socks, an industrial sized bottle of shampoo, a ceramic frog on a bike, a straw beach hat, a yoga mat, new pillows, ear buds, food storage containers, dog biscuits, an area rug, and gourmet chocolate covered raisins. And once found, I save a LOT of money on that spectacular dress!  Ross stores are generally organized...clothing, shoes, housewares, etc. are all consistently mapped out and marked well, but it can get messy and items are often strewn about. Unfortunately I live in a glass house, and like most shoppers here I occasionally suffer from buyer's remorse - half way through the store - and end up unloading the items I picked up earlier in places they don't belong.  Ross check out lines, however, are one of the things really bad nightmares are made of. There usually seems to be plenty of staff on hand, just rarely at the check out counters...maybe they're restocking all that misplaced inventory. Those lines can move slowly, and I've left entire carts behind just to spare myself the nightmare.

Clean and Organized. It's nice not having to scrounge through every single shirt to find sizes from the tag. The hangers already have the sizes on them and they're mostly all put together closely which makes finding clothes a breeze and efficient. Shoes aren't on random/other shoe size location and they're not everywhere on the floor like other Ross. They seem to always get new things in every week or two.

I wish I could give zero stars. This place is terrible. The manager, Elizabeth Sijwwade, cares nothing about customer service, is rude, and has lost my business with her rudeness and unprofessional attitude. Go somewhere else to spend your hard earned money.

Imagine a thrift store, with brand new stuff, that doesn't smell, most of it from name brands. That is how most Ross, Marshall's, TJ Maxx and Home Goods stores are. Even the clientele is similar if you go to a Ross in a bad neighborhood.  The Oro Valley location, while clean and not corrupt, has a very limited selection of items. I don't know if it's picked over very fast they just don't receive much. I find more selection in Ross's in shady neighborhoods. I have gotten great deals on mens fragrances from world renowned fashion houses like Jean Paul Gaultier and Calvin Klein. As well as various Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein shirts, pants, underwear, belts, duffel bags, shoes, socks, wallets, ect... Have also got a great deal on a hamper and Izod bed linens. Guess what? Most of my stuff never came from this location because they NEVER have anything

This review is solely on those who shop at Ross.....  We are all there for the same reason, to find a deal. With that being said, it's not a daycare center. Please don't let your children run free around the store to tear it up, bump into other customers and scream at the top of their lungs for no reason at all. Please be respectful of others shopping experience.  And to the store employees.... I know it's not your place or mine to babysit these children, but you could very well lose lots of customers because of this. Not to mention they tear up your store and could get seriously hurt.

This is definitely one of the nicest Ross stores. Its clean, well kept, and the lines are never long. However the selection isn't very large and has a lot less merchandise than the other locations. Everything is nicely seperated, making it very easy to shop. Its just driving all the way there may not be worth it.
Need more cashiers. Currently in line for almost an hour. Selection sucks. Thank god for home goods.

This review is based off being compared to other Ross stores, not just compared to any department store. I am so happy for this location! It is right next door to my gym and very convenient. Store was clean and organized, and associates were friendly.

I shop here regularly but went in for a few after Christmas returns. I had 4 items and forgot my receipt. Not sure why the associate couldn't look it up but no big deal. One item had been marked lower in price, again no big deal, and one item she said wasn't from Ross, it was a gift so that is possible and ok, no worries, She put the amount refunded on a store card (under $40). Which is all fine because like I said, I shop there a lot. The problem is, I was dressed down this time and the associate was obviously taking her bad day out on me and judging me for being dressed down! First she gave me and my daughters some dirty looks, who cares that my hair is up and were in sweat pants, then her NASTY ATTITUDE topped it off. I was so angry with how badly her service was that I will visit other stores instead of Ross from now on. I've never had anyone be so nasty to me as a customer. I spend a lot of money at this store,, but not anymore. This lady was unnecessarily rude!

Store was a mess at closing time while the workers stood around. I asked the manager with short black curly hair a question about an item and she was quick to dismiss me ..and to the customer behind me. I'll go elsewhere next time.

This store is pretty well put together compared to other Ross' I have been too. Aisles were not jammed packed either but definitely neat and easy to find things. All the departments were well organized. Made it easy to browse around and "find your treasure" so to speak. They had a really great shoe selection. By that I mean they had a lot of shoes in each size. Sometimes I go to Ross and they will have no shoes in my size or entire shelves cleared. So  I really appreciate them keeping up with organization as well as style for the season in all sizes. There is one thing I did notice the prices of there shoes are going up sorry but if I'm going to pay 50 dollars for shoes I'll go to a higher end store. Other then the shoes the clothes were all reasonably priced. They had a great range of accessories and housewares.

Worst customer service ever. I came in to return some shoes that didn't fit my kid. Unfortunately I lost the receipt. The cashier told me I not only couldn't exchange them for a bigger size but I could not return them NOT even for a store credit.

They are severally understaffed. I spent nearly 20 minutes waiting to check out even though only 3 people were ahead of me in line. When I got to the cashier I was told that they aren't honoring their reduced price sale. I asked why and the reason why only explained as "you can't have it". All in all, it was a very bad experience   Won't be back, a better TJ Maxx is next door.
NEVER WILL I EVER SHOP AT ANOTHER ROSS!!! Based on the shitty experience I just received at the Mt Juliet location!! Beyond RUDE!!! If I could've given negative stars I would've!

Brought in a return with receipt and Bosko accused me of switching products and said we dont sell mirrors like that. I was asked to checkout 20 mins before closing by the same rude man. Then when I was returning with and purchasing over 100 worth of items he tries to force me to put the return on store voucher. This man is insane. His cheerleader store watcher offered to call the police on me. Apparently disagreeing with them is against the law. These people are racist and a**holes. I will make sure I put this story everywhere so they can be called out for this racism.
Awful customer service. No one was very willing to help me for an item they apparently had "on hold" and no one even offered to help me locate it in the store. Messy and unorganized.

I just want to THANK the kind young man, David, who handled the returns I had the other day.  He was very efficient, helpful and pleasant to  work with.  I was in and out of there in a lot less time than I anticipated.  Thank you David and everyone at that ROSS!
Always a great selection of clothes for a great price. Staff is always friendly and helpful. I accidentally bought the wrong size shorts and the staff made exchanging them super easy.

Ross. Being completely honest I will say that I have been a semi frequent customer for years. Good prices made me overlook the general dirtiness and disorganization of this store. However, a visit to the Ross store on Gulf to Bay in Clearwater Florida yesterday completely blew me away and placed Ross on my BANNED list.   When I walked in there was a man wearing an all black SWAT team like uniform with the words "Loss Prevention Team" printed in white letters. Pretty severe I thought, but okay. So I walk to the back of the store pick out 4 items that I wanted to try on, and went to  The fitting rooms. I showed the attendant my items and said I had 4. "No" she said. She took them and hung them on a rack where she flipped through them. She then handed me a 4 card and the items. After trying on the items I went to give the card back and she took the items, hung them, and flipped through them again. There were five people waiting in line to go through the process I described.   I get it. Some people steal. And it costs stores a lot of money. But the whole shopping experience was not enjoyable whatsoever. I almost felt like I was going to be frisked.  Is the answer treating everyone like they're a criminal?  All stores must have theft problems. I haven't been to any other store that have put these practices into place.   So, just saying, if this happens to you at Ross don't feel they are singling you out. This smells like a company that may be on the verge of bankruptcy. And Ross, if you're listening, this may discourage shoplifters but it also is going to keep your customers from coming back to your store.

I've. just left this store today Saturday December 5 845am.     The worst clerk EVER.     She saw me standing there waiting to pay and totally ignored me Another clerk got her attention....No good morning or how are you just a very disgruntled lady that obviously wished she was somewhere else.    Listen up.     If you hate your customer service job that much  there's plenty of other people out  there that would be glad to have it.   Management.   Do your job

The reason I give the 4 stars is because of the service. I wish I knew the ladies name but she was very helpful.   If you are looking for bed sheets they have these sheets that are amazing called "Smartcool" which are wicking sheets that keep you cool when it's hot and warm when it's cold. Love these things and for some reason I can only ever find them at Ross. 30 bucks for a queen (500 thread count) set!

Most of these reviews are negative- unsurprising due to  the the psychological phenomenon known as the negativity bias. Anyway I came in today at around 5:30. the store was clean and employees were friendly and willing to help.I was greeted on the way in as well. All employees were also wearing masks properly which is important during the pandemic. Great experience!

This Ross has been one of the cleanest ones I ever seen. I finally found so many things that I wanted to buy here since other stores are always jam packed and I never find at least one thing that I need. As soon I walked in I was surprised because it's was so clean and everything is all organized. People here are friendly.

I love Ross! This store is clean, well organized, and usually has something I want but don't need. I've bought clothes, shoes, kitchen goods, and linens here. I usually go back to browse like once a month or so.
Found the cutest purse for my Angel Tree kid. The staff was very helpful in assuring me she would like it. Just in case she doesn't there's a gift receipt.
Super clean and organized, better stuff than other Ross' I've been in.. Love it!

The old Ross at the top of the hill in Northtowne was descent, usually Friday on mornings. They closed it an opened the new one across the street by Winco. What a disappointment! It's smaller, dingy-looking, and they barely have any shoes. I would give it zero stars if I could. I don't know what corporate head made this decision. The one on Keitzke is still descent.
