Ross is my go to for a lot of my clothes shopping. I was stuck wanting to change clothing, but not willing to make the hour long round trip to do so- so we left for an hour to shop- lol. Makes sense I think. I grabbed a pair of jeans and a top and then perused the dresses- because I always buy dresses from Ross and found one right away! Navy blue with aqua and teal flowers- gorgeous. I found mom and headed to the front. It was a decent size line crawling along and a slow pace. Mom continued to look around as I stood moving back and forth on my feet waiting to go to the next social distance marker. Finally I made it to the register- yay!!! A friendly face checked me out quickly. I guess I haven't clothes shopped in store in a long time- because I didn't realize dressing rooms are closed. Kinda caught me off guard. Mom teased me about it. At least everything fit!

Not the cleanest store, but I found what I needed.  If I was looking to browse, this is not the store where I would want to do it. I'm a clumsy person. I tend to run into door frames and trip over my own feet. When there are tons of racks strewn about the store, I can see death and dismemberment flashing before my eyes. Also, it's just not very nice looking seeing all these empty racks out and about.   This didn't bother me too much, however, because I was on a mission to find an oatmeal bowl. As many friends have pointed out, yes, I do own more than one bowl, but I only owned one bowl big enough that my slow cook oatmeal doesn't bubble over in the microwave. I like to live on the edge, thus the singular big enough bowl. I recently shattered mine (my husband jokes what is all the working out good for if I can't carry a bowl) and since I eat oatmeal at least once a day, I was on the hunt for a new one.   My husband stopped at Home Goods and couldn't find a bowl that fit my standards (although I question how hard he tried, but that's another story) and the bowls at Target were expensive! As we were pulling out of the Target parking lot, I spotted Ross and decided to make a quick stop.  We power walked in at about 9 p.m. and there were still quite a few people shopping. Ran to the home section and I found two bowls that fit my bill! One was prettier, but it was flimsier and only said: "may get hot when microwaved". So, I'm pretty sure that means it is microwavable safe, but my husband filled me with doubts. Therefore, I ended up with the bowl I lovingly call "the pineapple" since it is yellow with a pineapple texture. The flimsier bowl was $4.99 and this bowl was $6.99 and clearly stated "microwave and dishwasher safe". It also says it is handmade in Portugal, but I question the authenticity of that statement. After my sticker shock at Target, this price was perfectly acceptable.  They only had one cashier, but when the line got long they called in another. I was in and out in less than 10 minutes.  So, again, I wouldn't come here if I was browsing, but since I was on a mission, I rate this place A-OK.
Poorly maintained and poorly managed. Dressing rooms are small and smell, and there is constantly a  ridiculously long line to the cashier.
This is a newer Ross.  It's well maintained, clean and the staff are actually really nice.

By far the very WORST place I've ever have been to in my entire life! I don't recommend anyone to go there! Horrible customer service and I was disrespected by a lady at the cash register after I asked if I can purchase one of the hand bags and wouldn't unlock them so I can purchase one of them   RATE: 0 stars it's horrible in there!!!!!
I went in for some t-shirts and found some great deals throughout the store. The employees were very friendly.

It was colder than I expected while my time in Tampa. I was searching for a close by place for warm jackets and I found Ross. I found so many warm jackets and shawls. I'm so glad I came here. Lines weren't big at all. Highly recommend them if you're looking for warm sweaters and/or jackets

I am a Ross junkie. But not all Ross location are created equal, this one is an O.K. One, organized (an important factor in choosing the right Ross store)  but it doesn't have the best selection of household items, but would I be back? Sure, how could I resist passing by a Ross store without stoping to say hi?

This is the closest Ross to my house, so I've been here a handful of times... And I'm not that big of a fan! The selection is usually poor... Especially for anyone that wears over a size 12. Even for toddlers, you can't find much. Decor? Not that either. Toys? Nah. I'm really hoping they can get more items in soon, but until then while the dressing rooms are still closed, I'll go buy my items from a different location and return them here if they don't fit! That's about the only use I have for this store right now.

I've been to this location several times at different points of the day (opening, mid day & evening) & within a 2 month span. They have a variety of items to choose from:  household goods, kitchen & bath, luggage, family clothing, candles, pet supplies, garden supplies, furniture, jewelry, watches, perfume/cologne & condiments. (Whew lol) The staff for the most part will help you if needed. There was 1 young lady (not naming her or her position yet) who seemed to be having a bad day on two of my visits. I'll update on her if it continues.   The items are discounted pricing which is lovely. I had to return 1 item because it fell apart after 1 wear. I had no issues there as I miraculously retained the tags along with the receipt. (The universe must have known. Lol) The reason I gave 4 stars is because it seems like they're either always rearranging sections or are understaffed/unorganized in the stocking aspect...ALLEGEDLY LOL. This can be a bit frustrating but hey...I like the prices. Overall, I will be visiting again & update if necessary.

I am not a huge fan of this location primarily because of the customer service experience. I was looking for some items to decorate my office space and luckily I was able to find a nice selection of office decorations for reasonable prices. I will say this section of the store was probably the most organized. I walked down a few other aisles and there was no organization, items on the floor, and misplaced items throughout the aisle. In addition, I noticed that for clothes, mostly referring the the woman's section - the sizes of the clothes were not consistent with the signage which is annoying and makes the shopping experience that much harder. Once getting to the register, not one of the cashiers smiled, greeted you, or even showed a care that you were supporting their establishment. She also just threw all of my new items purchased into a bag with no care. My cashier talked so low I had to ask her to repeat the price more than once. I purchased items that were heavy but could not take the cart out of the store. I asked the cashier for a suggestion since I had too many items to carry in my hands and instead of offering to help, considering there were other store associates standing around talking to her, she told me to make more than one trip to my car.   I will say this is a nice size store compared to other Ross', but not sure I will go back. It's nothing worse than horrible customer service.
New, Clean Store but cashiers are unfriendly. Barely muttered a "hi" after I said "hello, how are you?" Also it was a long line with only one cashier.
I went there to find some new sandals, and although the shelves were pretty empty, I found the perfect pair of Clarks in my size!  Staff were very nice.

Wow very disappointed in this store. Bare, messy, & cold. Not one employee acknowledged me at any point in my visit to the store. Seems like this place is going out of business and fast. So messy I don't even think I could dig through the piles to see what I wanted. I will not be back.
shopping carts filthy ! shameful ! ross does not allow their shopping to be cleaned but only  " once a year " !!

I find this store takes a lot of patience and time in order to find something worthy of purchasing. It is a great place if you don't have anything specific in mind.  Not much to offer as far as customer service goes, since workers seem to be scarce, except at the dressing room area. They are strict on the amount of items you want to try on, and yes that bikini counts as two pieces.  Shoe prices vary from a great deal to over priced.

Most staff here isn't happy to be alive let alone to be at work.  There are a few people that flash a smile when entering or checking out, but they are rare and hard to find.  Items here are usually beat up and kind of dingy but lets me honest, it is SO fun looking for that diamond in the rough. Build some morale on staff and stock the shelves a little better and you're looking at a 4 star store.

I am not a huge fan of Ross usually, but during my recent travel I stopped in with my sister and Kiana (i think I spelled it right) was AMAZING. She helped us to carry the mirror we purchased to our car. She was very friendly and kind and exceeded our expectations.

If I could give zero stars I would and not because of the clothes selection. What I witnessed tonight was unacceptable, and down right disgusting.  I was being checked out this evening and couldn't help but notice the lady next to me in a wheelchair trying to get her money back for a pair of shoes.  They not only made her wait  30 mins while checking everyone else out, but by  the time " Jasmine " came to the register she was nothing but rude, not listening to the customer she wouldn't even make eye contact with her.  This lady in the wheelchair was the sweetest lady just waiting her turn. No matter how rude Jasmine was she never raised her voice she was very pleasant.  As I watched this I had to say something. I said it very quietly asking her politely not to be rude to this lady.  She then told me to mind my own business and a lot more that's not even important. The rude things she said to me didn't make a difference. I just wanted them to take their time with her and show her respect. The customer service that I witnessed today should never happen. I don't care if it's because of race, disability you are to treat every human with respect. After waiting outside I kindly told the cops (yes they called the police on this sweet lady)  I explained exactly what happened in there. I for one will never let another human being treat someone with so much disrespect nor could I stand there in silence as it happened.  If this is the type of employees you keep on your team this will be the last time I ever shop here again. I cannot even put into words how appalled I am that a young person (your employee) would treat a customer like this and not only a customer a disabled one at that! And after being called out she just got nastier and ruder. I will be calling more and explaining this experience to every corporate person I can.  I'm disgusted and appalled by this behavior and this women deserves an apology!

Everytime I visit this Ross, I am disappointed. Is there a reason why it's always so empty? Are they closing soon? All of the shelves look empty and have random things thrown everywhere. Everyone is very friendly though, but I have seen a few employees texting all though that doesn't bother me too much.

Tonight I ran into Ross with intent to be in and out. I was able to do exactly that thanks to Dani!! Although they are extremely short staffed the girls at the counter are super polite and helpful. They also work well while under pressure which is always nice to see! I had an issue and they were so accommodating, very happy I stopped in!!

I am a fan of Marshall's, TJ Max, and Home Goods. I guess had a lot of clothing for women, but that Is not why I go in there. I buy everything but clothing. Although I have made many purchases there I am not impressed with their level of inventory, plus this place looks like it hasn't been fully stocked yet. Also they never have high end items like Breville, All-Clad, Ralph Lauren drinking glasses, among other things. The store is clean but overall very empty. Look out Marshall's here I come.

This was the cleanest Ross that I have ever seen. I am still astounded by it. Friendly service, clean floors, clothes actually hung in the racks that correspond to their sizes.   They had a great selection of shoes including a bunch of doc martens and Steve maddens. Heck this store even had all of the shoes where they were supposed to be organized by size. Insane!  The kitchen area was what I came in here for and it was just as clean as the rest. I was very happy to find a 5 pack of bamboo utensils for under $4. Let alone nothing was broken or out of its packaging.   The staff was friendly and helpful. I was able to try on several pairs of shoes without the beeper tags tiring them together easily by asking and then they asked me if I needed additional pairs freed. So I was able to try on several ore pairs very easily.   Thanks for having such a customer centric store.

If you're not expecting Macy's when you go in, you'll be fine. :)   Along the lines of Marshalls, TJ Maxx and Goodwill ;), you have Ross.  The selection can be hit or miss.  My cart is either empty, or overflowing.  Picked up a couple white elephant gifts for a couple bucks, and they were a big hit at the party.  I can also almost always find at least one dress to buy, and I'm not a dress person at all.  I think each location has its own specialties or strengths, so don't give up after one time, or after one store.  It's worth going back again a time or two to try it out.  TJ Maxx has a better selection of home goods around here, as does one Marshalls...the other one doesn't.

Didn't appreciate that MOD would not give us a discount on an item that said "2-piece" and we only had one piece. Said that she could take our name abd if found someone will call us byt we had to pay full price. Will not be visiting this location anymore.

I really like Ross. I'm not from St. Louis and in my hometown we only had Ross. We didn't have Marshalls or TJ Maxx; just Ross. Ross is similar to these stores but it's also got some differences. I personally prefer it to these others.   I was really happy to see this one in Sunset Hills and even happier when I saw that there is one opening up in Wentzville. Super excited. Ross isn't my favorite store but it's nice to see after being without it for the last 4 years. It's familiar and I missed it.    Ross is a great option for affordable clothing. I recently left with 3 tops (Michael Stars, Michael Kors), 1 large giraffe print beach bag and a 5-pack of monkey-themed Carter onesies for my newest nephew.... all for about $35.00! I mean, really, you can't beat that. I really regret leaving behind a beautiful gold shimmer scarf by Calvin Klein for only 12.00 but as my husband loves to tell me, I can't have everything I want.   It's a great place for home goods; everything from dishes to mirrors to quality sheets. They have baby, kids, teens, mens, womens, and plus size clothing. They have pet supplies (including some really nice pet beds), luggage, sunglasses, jewelry, beauty products, handbags, shoes, and other accessories.   This one in particular is actually the cleanest Ross I have ever been to. It's bright and airy. The floor was clean and everything was arranged nicely. I didn't see a layer of dust on anything.   A few negatives;  -The fitting rooms are old/dark/dirty compared to the rest of the store. I can't remember what was in this location before Ross but I feel like these haven't been redone in a very long time.  -Even though this is a large store, there seemed to be a lot of empty floor space. I'm used to Ross just being absolutely full of stuff. That's kind of the fun part.. Looking through everything. This one, not so much. They're open until 9:30pm on weekdays!  Great selection of handbags for the Monday blues.  Sure there's a bunch of last year's fads, but there's also some designer clothes that offer timeless basics like white cotton shirts and black skirts.  Stop hating!

This Ross is probably one of the nicest ones around. The clothes are neat, the aisles are well kept, and the staff is decent. Many of the other stores tend to be messy but this location is usually always pretty clean, which makes it easier to browse. It's smaller so it has less of a variety.

Cashier Carol very rude person.  She was offering  and giving 10% discount in 5/15/18   I went with my Aunt and Cousin they bought at lest $300 just on a Tuesday and around $500 during The Weekend. I asked her why she didn't have them the senior discount my aunt is 69 years old. She said because my cousin was paying and she's not senior. This lady Carol saw my cousins using my aunt credit card to pay.  She was really upset since we got to the register when she heard them speaking Spanish.  Carol is a very rude person. And it's wrong to treat any Spanish customers like that. She probably forgot that most of Mexican clientele pays for her salary

Fell in love with the Ross stores in Vegas so I was pretty excited to find out we were getting one.  Came in opening morning to find it well stocked and ready to go!  Cane back 2 days later when I had more time and the place is packed with customers.  However haven't found anything that was an amazing deal yet.  Yet.....
The day we went, minimal clearance.. Pretty poorly maintained and organized.  Dumpy looking.
Will not be going here again. Love the store in general, but most ladies that work at this location are so rude and make for a bad shopping experience. Go elsewhere
Good place if you like to bargain. Can't really stand searching through stuff but must say you can find sum really good clothes if you take your time.

I go to ross's at least once a week and really I think they forget to ship home décor to this store, the selection is lacking and it does not have many items.  2 weeks ago this past Tuesday I went to the checkout line (I was the only one checking out), 3 employees (1 in returns, 1 in jewelry and one hanging out in the front) all seen me and not a single person said a word. So after aprx. 5 min I left the items and left the store, the same 3 ladies looked at me and never sais a word.  Poor poor management and lazy employees.

Horrible. Messy. Lazy employees.  The line went to the back of the store by the dressing room. Only 2 people at the register. I can see employees walking the floor but not doing anything. I told them to come do their job and get the manager.  Finally they got 4 people at the register.. Only AFTER I told them. Lazy lazy people. Your job isn't hard. No excuse!!
this Ross is awful. I've been waiting in line for 10 minutes. They have 2 people working the registers and there are 15 people in line. Don't shop here unless you have a few hours to kill.

Stopped into this Ross on Friday before going to Trader Joe's.  The store was spotlessly clean, super well-organized, the people working there were very nice.  Got a great Calvin Klein down vest for $8.99!!  Almost bought a couple of nice table lamps, they were $20 each.  Very good selection of shoes and home goods and a huge children/baby section.  Will definitely be back.

It's Ross... what would you expect?  Shoes in shambles? Check. Clothes sardine-packed and disorganized? Check. Super-long lines and apathetic employees? Check.   Cheapest clothes in Santa Barbara? Check and Check.   Ross is the best place for clothes shopping in SB because it is the ONLY place you can find inexpensive clothes, shoes and handbags. The only other options you have in town are Macy's, Nordstrom's, Saks 5th Avenue (yah, right) and countless boutiques.   You can call it a glorified flea market but I would rather dig through Ross than overpay for a better shopping experience.
the only thing I like about this location is the they never have a line but the men  selection could use  some expending.
Today I went in to Ross   I like shopping there but not today I had to wait for a return only one person for returns ??? Need to have other people helping with returns too .
Things are a mess in this store. Also restrooms are out of service!! Where do employees go?

The only positive thing I can say about this place is you can get a few essentials for a great price; some items for the home in particular. My boyfriend made out well with some shorts and casual shirts; but overall it was crowded and dirty with awful customer service. It's going to take some convincing to get me to ever take a trip back here to look for a bargain.
I hate coming to this Ross, with 20 people waiting in line, only 2 cashiers open! Ridiculous! One cashier for return merchandise and one for buying!!!  They need better staffing!

Whenever I go here I need to decide if the thing I want to buy is worth the line. I've literally walked up to the line with something, put it back, and then walk out the store because the line is so long. They'll have one person at the registers and the line will be 15 people long.

This is one hoppin' Ross Dress for Less. I've never seen so many people in line at one Ross Dress for Less, so the first thing that may strike you is the space-age system they've devised where a recorded voice directs you to the next available cashier. Very sharp. Given the volume, they do a good job of keeping the clothes racks relatively orderly. The merchandise is the usual hodgepodge of clothing that's irregularly sized, comically ugly, or flagrantly emblazoned by designers that you've never heard of, making it a great place to buy shirts for work. This Ross Dress for Less is also a hot spot for animated bible stories on DVD.
You find treasures in the haystacks. I like shopping at Ross stores. $$$ will be saved

The men's section is really sparse. The same goes for other sections. I've been to a lot of Ross stores, so I know what I'm talking about. I guess the comparatively small inventory allows them to keep the store so clean and orderly. Not the best Ross, not the worst.
They have a large inventory at least. The store is okay clean and organized. The checkout line is super slow and the dressing and restrooms can get downright disgusting.

Went here to browse around. This is one of the most unorganized Ross stores I've been to. I understand you have to "find your treasure" but things just piled on each other in every aisle. It was pretty early in the day and not busy so just looks like the store was not faced before opening rather then customers messing up the aisles.but I could be wrong. Honestly it gave me anxiety so I ended up leaving after ten minutes.

I've got one big heaping steaming problem with ROSS: Baffling inconsistent pricing.    I found a pair of shoes I loved. They were way too big for me, so I spent the next hour searching through the chaotic hell of the shoe aisles to find my size. After much pushing, shoving and sore lack of manners by fellow shoppers, I could not believe it, there they were! One pair, my size, in a sea of mismatched mayhem! One problem: the size 9 shoes were on sale for an unbelievably low price, the ones in MY size that I found after nearly an hour of searching were a different, much higher price. SAME SHOE, SAME BRAND, SAME COLOR, even, so I took them to the customer service desk & asked for the sale price. I was informed that no, they could not give me that price. There was no good reason for it. I was miffed.   If you want a good deal, it certainly can be found at ROSS, but long lines, loud obnoxious mechanical voiced customer cues for "next in line" and pushing shoving crowds of moronic mannerless classless cretins are not my cup of tea. Neither is a customer service desk that cannot make a change to something so simple as my request for the sale price on a shoe that was already marked down to sale!  LAME. Also, this store is pretty dirty. They really could learn to clean it up a bit. Nasty!  Don't even get me started on the parking lot!!!

Generally I love Ross, however many of the employees seem to loathe their jobs and do not pay close attention to checking out customers and removing the heavy duty security tags with the ink attached to items such as rugs and clothing. Last week I went in got some jeans for my three year old, for some reason the security tag was placed inside the back pocket of these toddler jeans. Unbeknownst to me I took the price tags off and put the jeans on my three year old. I couldn't understand why she was screaming crying bloody murder until I took them off and found the pin needle from the security tag in the back pocket of these children's jeans with the stabbing needle stick thru the inside of her pant leg. Needless to say I guess I can't rely on people to properly do their jobs. Poor kid has a gash on her thigh now.

The customer service here sucks! Wasn't able to try on Spanx/shorts, they told me to purchase them and return them if they don't fit. What a waste of time, so I definitely didn't buy anything. The Ross in Goleta is a lot  better, they let me try on Spanx, but didn't have my size. Consistency is key to running any business. Get it together Ross

Worst experience ever ! The cashier slammed my bags down and was rude didn't greet me at all horrible customer service! I'll never be back to this location! Not to mention I called and complained to the manager and he didn't care at all!

I think it is weird to have to rate a department store so low but this one has been given many chances. Every time I try to shop here, it's something ridiculous. First let me mention that it's a product ghost town compared to other Ross I've visited and actually enjoying shopping at. And then there's the employees. There are three that always seem pleasant (three young ladies, two with short haircuts, wish I could remember their names) but everyone else is always trying to make their bad day your bad day. Then I've actually had a male worker not try to give me the price that was on the tag. Unbelievable. Another time, a young lady would not take my return, although I had my receipt, product unused and still in bag. Shenanigans. And another time I was followed and watched throughout the store. Disgusted. I've shopped at Ross since like 2003...but I am never coming back to this one.

In the 80s and 90s Ross was one of my shopping hubs.  Back then the buyers would score collections by well known department store brands. I could put together cute mix and match outfits at great Ross prices.  Now, this kind of offering seems to be no more.  You might want to go with zero expectations and just see what catches your eye.  I'd say that you could be luckier with accessories for home or personal fashion than for basic items.  Stopped in to this previous favorite location last night and was surprised to be greeted by a young man in a suit out front.  While he was very polite, I had the sense of being welcomed by a bouncer.  Then inside the door a security guard was the next to welcome me.  Hmm, something has changed!  Once I made a few selections and walked the gauntlet through parents' worst nightmare - racks of snacks in the register line (!), I had to wait to check out.  They had more security personnel working than cashiers.  Not very helpful.  The overall effect felt like shopping in a minimum security prison.  Weird vibe.

This Ross is located in very nice location with a variety of shops.  Pros: They had a great selection of items and clothing and it was very clean. No line but very slow...only one cashier.  Cons: There was no one at the fitting room so you help yourself to a number to try on clothes. Also, there's no one in site to help you find anything you are looking for. No greeter at the door (usually a security always greets you at other locations). The cashier had no customer service skills, she looked tired and unfriendly (never utter a word).  Gave it two stars because they have a good selection.  If there's another Ross in the area go there if you want a nice and friendly environment.

Ross Stores is along the lines of TJ Maxx and Burlington Coat Factory, except that it's more haphazard and disorganized, at least for this location. This store is the first in Central Indiana, and it just opened recently (October 2016). Perhaps they are still working on its operations and getting the inventory in order.  Just like similar retailers, Ross carries brand-name goods at discount prices. Expect to find apparel, accessories, footwear, and household items. The selections were just okay and I didn't find any compelling buys, although prices were competitive compared to other discount stores.  If you are doing some shopping in the Castleton area, you might as well stop by Ross. Perhaps you will find some unexpected deals there. Other competitors are nearby so you can always bundle your trips together.

I enjoy this store, it's located off of 82nd street in Indy by the Trader Joe's. Ross is something that I was never exposed to until I moved to Indiana. This Ross is a good size in my opinion, right in the middle, not to big not to small.  Wide selection of products, bath and beauty, and I think you find items that aren't always in target. There is also a great selection of shoes that usually go with the season as well as purses and luggage options. woman and men's clothing options are all in the middle, and I have found a great selection of different pieces each time I've visited. The home goods section is also worth checking out, they always have a unique selection of sauces and spices, and different decoration options as well. Prices are great, and you always find something fun and useful. I'm a happy repeat shopper

With Marshall's right next door, this place should go out of business.  While Marshall's gets the out of season stuff, Ross get the damaged, ugly, cheaply made stuff 90% of the time.  Sometimes you'll find some pretty cool stuff, especially in the home section, but for the most part I try to avoid this store.  It's so dusty (possibly moldy) and dark, that it's not even pleasant to be in at any time.

Ghetttttoooooo....this store should be an SNL skit. The workers do not speak proper English and hate their job and the customers. They only have one line open always. The one line is so incredibly long that I have seen people come into the store just to take a picture on their phone and leave. They have LOTS of affordable dresses but u have to block out extra time in your day to wait in the mile long line. The children's section is always empty with a few broken toys. I wish I could shop here for their great dresses but I have kids and can't make them wait 30 min+ in a line.

I'm not a huge fan of this Ross. The discounts are for sure worth all of the digging, but this particular store can get pretty dirty and cluttered.   Also, ever since the bigger Ross opened in Goleta, I feel there are better quality items being sent to the Goleta store than to the Santa Barbara store.   I'll still continue to shop here and look for deals on items but it's not my first choice. Some of the nicer items I've found have been destroyed from being tossed on the ground or a sticky child got to it. Too bad, with a little TLC, this could be a great location.

Ross can be overwhelming at times, but you have to weigh the pros and cons.  For our first reviewer, his con list obviously is the only list he has.  But for me, there are good and bad aspects, like any discount store, but overall Ross has good prices on a variety of clothing.  I love finding oversized cute handbags for $13.00 and Steve Madden shoes for $17.99.  Sometimes I go and find a ton of stuff and other times I don't find anything.  I've stocked my kitchen with high quality cooking and baking items for an average of $5.00 each so that in itself is worth bypassing KMART for any starving college student in need of kitchen basics.  All in all, if you've got an hour to kill and you're in the mood to find some discount clothes, shoes, accessories or home decor - stop on by Ross and don't forget the Starbucks next door - friendliest staff in my opinion.

Was in there Saturday night.  No AC on in the store at all. Was an uncomfortable oven.  Even the employees were not happy about having no AC.  Not sure who the manager was Saturday 09/08/18 was but............you suck!! Don't save $$$ and kiss corporate *ss at both the customers and your own employees expense. Was so hot it there I started feeling sick.  Not cool. Also only one cashier so wait times to check out are longer. Poor management on Friday and Saturday nights there should be more than one cashier.  The rest of the employees are hiding elsewhere in the store acting like they are doing something important.

I came here at 939p. The store is suppose to be open until 10p. Their doors were locked and unable to access the store. Very disappointed in their customer service. I just had to pick up one item before my vacation tomorrow.

I enjoy this Ross location. The staff is pretty friendly and I've been able to snag some good finds in here. No complaints!  At first I couldn't find the proper entrance to the shopping center off of Rt-70, because there are like nine other entrances around one little area, but it may also just be because I'm a moron. ;)
Meh. The K-Mart of discount stores. Not so organized. Decent prices. Cheap housewares. Okay if you don't want to fight the traffic and madness across the street at TJMaxx or Burlington.
WORST STORE EVER!!! With Really BAD "Securities" Acusing People Of Stealing Things With No Proof!!! With Securities Like That Your Store Is Going To Start Loosing Customers...

It's cheap, that's the only good thing. This store is always a wreck. It's dirty. It's disorganized. The checkout lines are always long when I go there. I'm glad I'm making more money now and can shop somewhere else.

The new manager is really great. I wanted to buy a rug but couldn't figure out how to get it in my cart since it was so big. So when I got to the register I told the woman and she said the manager would help me but he's out helping another customer load her car. When he came back in,  he carried the rug to check out, rang me up and took a little money off since the rug was unwrapped, AND helped me load it into my car. I appreciated the extra customer service on top of the great prices. Kudos to the manager!!!

This Ross has the best dresses but the line is so long u have to bring a good book bc u will be standing in the line for 30 min. One time I watched an entire Friends episode on my phone while waiting in line. Sometimes they will put two cashiers up there but usually there is only one. They have lots of other scary mean workers lurking around the store that are unwilling to help the customers. Also they shut down their dressing rooms often and open these 2  pop up dressing rooms that are really small and smelly. And there is a long line for those also. The store is actually the worst store I have ever been in, but the dresses are so good and cheap and women love a good deal so..

Me encanta ir a Ross porque de vez en cuando me va súper bien con las cosas que encuentras ahí .. Marcas caras a medio precio como quien dice .. Lo único malo es que es como buscar un alfiler en una montaña de paja ...

They have a good selection here but the reason for my 3 stars is based on customer service. I had a guy named Kay as my cashier. He was very rude and unprofessional. I'd ask him a question and he'd roll his eyes before he answered with a low voice. He doesn't have great customer service skills and shouldn't be working with customers if he's going to have that attitude.

This Ross USED to be my favorite, but has gone down hill. Loss prevention stereotypes you and follow you around the store. I understand they have a job to do, but don't make it obvious. Loss prevention employee acted like they were looking at kids clothes while I was looking at kids shoes. Management fix this issue ASAP

Disappointing. The store was practically empty. The best part of the store is that it's neat but that's only because it's EMPTY!  Very disappointed.  I even went twice.  Couldn't even find stemless wine glasses.

I really only go to Ross for dresses and for homegoods. Ross itself is not known for having very nice stores but they do have good deals! This particular Ross normally has pretty long lines when you are going to check out but the people who work there are always apologetic. I just wish they had more cashiers!

This place is very hit or miss. Tonight was definitely a hit when it came to the bargains I found;perhaps it was due to the fact that no one else was crazy enough to shop today.  I found a gorgeous dress with cream top and black lace skirt for the low price of $6.99.   On my way to the register, a rack of shoes caught my eye and I found the most gorgeous pair of boots I've ever seen. They were taupe thigh-high boots with quilted gold and brown interior and topped off with a bow in the rear of the top of the boot. Originally $39.99, I got them for $22.99.  It's days like this that make shopping worth it.

Ross has lured me away from the way too expensive Khol's.  I like the MacDade Store in Glenolden.  The store is clean and I can actually find pants that fit.  I'm petite and finding pants is tough.  Ross has great pants at a great price.  The only downside would be the stocking of the store.  It is either hit or miss.  The racks are either very full or very empty.  I have received compliments on the lovely fall capes and tops I  have bought there.  I've become a loyal customer.
i'd rather be eaten alive by rabid coyotes than shop in this glorified flea market.
Good selections.  Abundant stock. Well categorized. Lots of toys for the tots. One of the best Ross stores in PA and it's tidy. (CA stores are quite a bit bigger overall, I noticed)

My favorite place to shop for dresses at a bargain price! Yesterday was no different! I have a formal event & needed a great dress on a budget- $30 for a gown- Heck YEAH! BRING ON THE SEQUINS! Mom and my daughter helped me pick & the dressing room associate broke the tie!

I only go to this store if I absolutely have to.  Occasionally I will step in to see if it looks any better or if they got new management.  But yeah 3 years now and the store always looks junkie.  No merchandising skills at all....just throw it on a hanger or toss it on a shelf.  Really quite disappointing, you can still have a store that is closeouts and have it look good...just takes some pride in your work.  You can never find help if you need it here and no matter what there is always a line at the register.

Was shopping nearby, so I thought I would check out the new store. Never was in a Ross and will not be returning. I had purchased a few greeting cards (picture an eight by 6 inch transparent plastic bag) that I was carrying when I entered Ross. I was greeted with the clerk asking me to tie the bag. If a store is more worried about me "shop lifting" then shopping, it is not where I choose to spend my time or dollars! I was in and out in less than two minutes, not a great way to greet or welcome prospective customers.

I thought they were with JUST opening...or, closing ...they had THAT little merchandise.   I've NEVER seen a Ross like this...how do they make their bills and payroll?  I'll probably never visit this location again...how sad as its with other stores that draw in shoppers. Ross corporate needs to shape up.
Lines longer than LIZA and only one cashier, obviously a manager up front and she didnt jump in a checkstand. BOO
It's so disappointing to go into a fitting room and no one's there to help you because the company doesn't want to hire people

I don't shop at Ross very often. I only go there for household items and cheap basic shirts. I got a really nice white cotton shirt for under 10 dollars, perfect for Tucson weather. The shoes are not very organized. You might find some size 7s in size 9 isle.
Not much to look through. There are more "loss prevention" workers than cashiers. You would probably getter faster service if you tried to steal something than waiting in line to pay!

A friend in the golf business told me that I would be stunned at what I could find in the way of high quality major name brand shirts for low prices at these locations.  Well, he was right. What he failed to add was the crap I would have to deal with to actually make the purchase.  I was barely out of my car in the parking lot and a couple approached me asking if I knew of anyone hiring. Seriously, you're in a mall parking lot. So why don't you go into a store and ask a manager!  Upon entry to the store, I walked past not one, but two security guards very carefully watching the front door.  My friend instructed me exactly where to look for the golf shirts and I must say that I easily found a gem from the Nike family that ran 2/3 less than original retail and about half what I would have paid on Ebay. Maybe I just got lucky, but the sizes on this rack were very well organized...unlike what others on Yelp have said about this store.  Checking out was not nearly as efficient and I sense that is almost always the case based on how things are set up near the cashiers.  I'm happy to get the shirt, but was even happier to get the heck out of this place.

Upside: it has improved greatly since my first visit Downside: there's still room for improvement in stock and quantity   This store is suppose to be comparable to TJMaxx or Marshall's. I feel that those stores have better quality and definitely more quantity. I'm able to find a large plethora of designer and name brand items at those stores. Not so much at Ross. Also, this location is severely understocked. They have quite a few empty shelves throughout the store. However, they were more empty on my first visit a few days after their grand opening. This store looks nothing like the generic store photos they uploaded here. I've been to other Ross locations in northern Indiana, North and South Carolina, and Vegas. They were all better than this one.  I was able to find some home decor items at good prices, but it seemed as though I could only find one of everything. If I wanted two or more, I was SOL. In my opinion, this store is no match for TJ Maxx across the street. It needs to be stocked better to compete. One good thing, you don't have to wait in line as long in Ross.
love the discounts. Once in awhile you can find amazing deals. My size is not an easy fit so ...... I like the wide selection. Easy to return if something is not right.

Clean and Organized. It's nice not having to scrounge through every single shirt to find sizes from the tag. The hangers already have the sizes on them and they're mostly all put together closely which makes finding clothes a breeze and efficient. Shoes aren't on random/other shoe size location and they're not everywhere on the floor like other Ross. They seem to always get new things in every week or two.

I went in for some new clothes. Wasn't going to spend much money to begin with. I went to check out and the line wasn't super long. I ended up waiting in checkout line for 25 minutes. I only had 14 dollars worth of product to purchase so I almost put it back and walked out. There was only one cashier. The other associate was waiting for a manager for the entire 25 minutes and didn't bother checking people out in the mean time. The other associate was just slow but that's not her problem. Multiple associates kept walking by, paying no attention to the ever growing check out line. Kind of ridiculous!

This is my first ever review after using yelp for years. I am a ROSS fan and after being to many in many different cities, I appreciate this one even more. Just had to give this Ross and the employees here their well over due thanks. This store is very busy and most of the time with Mexican nationals not US citizens. No problem there, but more work for the staff. They keep moving and working hard and though not always the most cheerful, never rude! Thanks. Keep up the good work!

Keeps getting worse. Always a long check out line. Only about 10% cheaper than Target. Can barely fit one cart down the aisles, let alone two. Someone in a wheelchair could really bring down the ADA hammer on this place. They need to get rid of about half their clothing racks and cut prices by a third.

Christmas Holiday & only 2 checkers?! Over 30 people in line behind me! Totally ridiculous! Ross is my daughters favorite store & she is in town so we thought we would grab a few things! 25 minutes in line! Come on!!

I gave one star but honestly that's being generous! I live near this Ross and it's always been a good place to shop if a little crowded at the weekends. My son and I went here the other day and we were both in shock at the state of the place. It was overcrowded with the racks shoved together so you could barely get one cart down an aisle let alone one in each direction. I went into one aisle and couldn't even get out the other end because it was blocked by a pillar. The line for the checkout snaked halfway to the back of the store because only two checkouts were open. We couldn't believe how bad the store was and we ended up just leaving and going next door to Marshals. Unless they improve drastically, I won't be going back.

While the store and the employees were really sweet, the store manager, Haley is absolutely a horrible person. She is outright disrespect and in her position pretty foul mouthed. I wouldn't ever go back to this location.

Typical of Ross stores a little chaotic; but if you have the time to dig & look around your sure to find some really good deals.  They have everything from clothing for the entire family; shoes, household items as well as luggage & some exotic treats. If you find it buy it because it'll be here today & gone tomorrow name brands for less.

Hurrah!  I went next door to a crafts shop to pick up a specific item - they had a limited supply and were pretty expensive. On a whim, I popped here and found exactly what I needed, and for the same price, I got four of them. SOLD.    Ross can be hit or miss with products. Seemed to be less home goods these days as shelves were a bit bare.
Fall and Halloween Decor already picked over. Very disappointing. Most often it's hit or miss with this location.

This Ross has a pretty large selection of inventory and sometimes ends up with cooler stuff than the other places in town, but it's also messier and a lot of the staff are really unfriendly.  I was just perusing the racks tonight looking for some deals on summery dresses now that it's fall, and after I excused myself when passing this employee (a pregnant blonde woman) she started making weird comments about how I was fine as long as I didn't mess up her hangers or move the dresses. I was being perfectly polite and not messing anything up or moving anything. Anything I touched I put how I found it. After a few minutes, she randomly said to me in an aggressive tone "If you need a fitting room, let me know." I said "Ok, thanks." She replied, completely unnecessarily, "Yeah, you can't go in there without me there to let you in." I've never seen her before and I wasn't trying to get a fitting room so I don't know why she was treating me like some kind of troublemaker. I walked away because I was uncomfortable but came back to peruse the dresses on my way out of the store. Same employee said loudly on the Walky talky "Ugh, this girl is going through my dresses AGAIN. I just worked really hard to make sure they were all perfect." I hadn't messed anything up! I didn't move anything or knock anything off the hanger and if I had I would have cleaned up after myself.   As a former retail employee I totally understand that making sure that everything remains organized in the wake of customers can be a frustrating task, but that was just so rude of her. Throughout the rest of the store every employee but the cashier gave me the cold shoulder. Just weird.

Always a good place to pick up bargains - if you dig deep enough.  Plenty of parking in this huge lot.  I needed some basic kitchen gear and they had it at a steeply discounted price.  They also have a good selection of clothes for all sizes of women.  Don't plan on a quick rendevous here, you really need to spend some time poking through the shelves to look for bargains. They usually have a really good selection of bedding and towels and things for the bathroom and kitchen.  Shelves in pretty good shape.

Errrrbody loves a Ross! They have the best dresses ..how've the line at this one wraps around the store sometimes into the aisles with maybe one or two cashiers working. And they look ANGRY! There are other unhelpful workers lurking around he store but no one comes to help. The line is brutal and never ends and no one cares.

The worst ROSS store you can go to! First of all, it's not organized as other reviewers mentioned. Secondly, one of the workers was REALLY rude to me. Long story short, I went to the fitting room to try on 2 dresses. the worker was standing there in an angry way. As I approached her, she pretended that she is doing something. I said, "Hello, I would like to try these on." She just ignored me for a couple of minutes. She turned and said to me, "what." I repeated myself, and she started shouting at me in an angry way, "hold the number sign of how many items you have." I was really shocked because I was polite and talked to her nicely. Thus, I just left that area, she continued yelling, "yeah...go."  I was looking for a worker to ask why, but there was no worker to find around. So, I waited in line to talk to someone at the register. I told the person at the register about what happened and the person said to me, "oh, she got a problem hearing." I said back, "I understand, but that's not how a person with hearing problems talks because I've dealt with people with hearing problems for so long. Ross Dress for Less lives up to it's name. If you are looking for stylish clothing, I wouldn't recommend Ross, although once in a while you can find a hidden treasure. If you're living on a budget, Ross is a good option. At this particular location in five points, there is a loss prevention staff member named Steffany, who has helped me on more than one occasion with questions and is extremely friendly and helpful, and is a great individual to be greeted by and see as you are leaving. Unfortunately, a majority of the other staff could use some customer service training. I also believe additional cashiers during busy hours would improve the shopping experience greatly as lines can get frustratingly long. The furniture section is not large but has some good finds that look pretty standard and hold up well for a reasonable, perhaps slightly below average, cost. I rate this establishment at this location 3 stars because it provides what is advertised (lower costs), has a decent variety of options, but the quality of clothing is a bit cheap and the staff are generally pretty unapproachable (will not offer help unless asked, even if you accentuate the classic "very lost" look, and are often chatting with other staff ignoring the customer's needs)

Of all the Ross Stores I've ever been in, this is the most disorganized and inefficient store I've ever walked into. Yes.  The older cashier has a serious problem. She loves to be able to send you to the back of another line because she has to handle a return.  She's miserable but that aint rubbing off on me! Seriously? Only one register open on a Sunday evening?! I think I spent more time standing in line than I did shopping. Workers seem to be very scarce here.

My daughters  had to go alone into the dressing rooms while I sat outside on the big blue bench, really? Was i going to steal something? Half of the fun of shopping is seeing the good, the bad, the ugly.  This is the worst shopping experience ever, not coming back.

Products: Lots of super cute decor for your home...at super low prices. Not my style but they had lots of lounge clothes and some formal dresses (more so for the moms out there *hehe*). Pretty good selection of shoes, ranging from booties to sneakers. The store doesn't look as nice as it could look, but if you look past that superficial-ness you can find some cute things!   Employees/Service: I received a warm 'hello' when I walked in and the lady that checked me out was really sweet too. The man by the dressing rooms was beyond lazy and unprofessional. He didn't acknowledge me when I was clearly waiting for him to give me a number token, didn't acknowledge another lady either. He was just on his phone texting and I did his job for him by returning the token and hanging up the clothes I didn't want. He didn't count them or ask how they fit. They could do without him. Anyways, besides that employee, I had a good first time experience here and recommend it to those who need home decorations!
Found what I needed right away however... Ridiculously long line because they decided to have 2 registers open !! Friends went next door to TJ max and they finished before me!

What is going on in this strip mall? All of the stores here are terrible. Get it together, Algiers.  Okay, so this Ross is a mess. They will need to get their kinks worked out for the checkout lines.  The parking lot doesn't seem like it will be adequate for the volume of cars that you would expect from all of the big name stores that are opening here. Hopefully it will all work out.

I finally managed to visit this Ross. I drive by it almost every day and hadn't checked it out yet, but I needed a dress at the last minute and I thought I'd give this store a try. The only thing I had an issue with was approaching the entrance from Claiborne; I didn't realize that you couldn't turn into the lot from Claiborne. But now I know. Nice clean store with a good selection of merchandise. Just go in with an open mind and chances are good that you will find something you like at a price you like even better...

Waiting in long lines while watching employees talk on phone and deal with hangers is very frustrating

It's a good store. I've been here a number a times, but at other locations. There are things here for my wife as far as furnishings and other stuff, but not much for me.  Although, every now and then I find a gem for me lol.

Ross is one of my favorite stores. The products are of good quality and the prices are excellent. (Not pricey at all) Shopped their for clothes,  never a hassle. In the past I've shopped for decorative items for the home, gifts, shoes, you name.  NEVER A BAD SHOPPING EXPERIENCE..
Love this store very nice prices, and every chance I get I go and always find something I need or want! One of my favorite stores!!!

Ross can be really, really good, or a total waste of time.  Unfortunately for me, I experienced the later.  The racks were empty and some items I did see, were more expensive than I've seen at other stores.

. The bathrooms were trashed, no toilet paper in the dispenser. No soap. There was that funny unwashed smell. Sale floor was disorganized. Staff was friendly though.

Ross is a weird version of TJ Max, Marshall's and Stein Mart. It actually reminded me of Marshall's in the old days. Their racks of clothes really had no organization, except for the fact that they were separated by size. The sales associate who assisted us informed us they get trucks daily, so since they didn't have what we wanted today to check back because the inventory and offering change daily. Wow, rocket science in the world of retail.   I didn't find anything to add to my closet, but they had some great offering on gadgets and gizmo's for my tool box. The housewares department was rather small, but offered some good bargains. They also had some great gift baskets with sweet and salty treats for the holiday gift exchange. Some of them were even labeled gluten free.  The employees were friendly, but the check out system moved rather slow.  Even though I found the store to be disorganized, I think I'll return. After all, they get trucks everyday which means it will be a new shopping experience.

This location is new-ish (within the last 5 years, this entire shopping center was built), and surprisingly neat and clean. There is plenty of parking in front. This is near the middle of the strip mall. I am sure near the holiday season, parking will get tighter, as well the cleanliness of the store will deteriorate. I am rarely asked if I need help when I am at this location, though it is easy enough to find what I am looking for here. Customer service at check out is efficient enough, but nothing outstanding. Don't expect the cashier to make much of any conversation or to be quick.   Go to the location in Metairie. It may be a bit of a drive, but there are more employees for assistance and parking isn't as restrictive even during peak shopping times.

I love Ross stores. Although there were customers waiting for checkout, cashiers were moving them through quickly.

Since there isn't a Ross near me in Michigan, I have to shop at one in whatever city I visit that has one. Best Ross store I've been to!  Clean and bright store with attentive but not pushy staff.

Love this location and the selection they offer, will definitely be back again when I'm in the area.

Going forward, I'll happily shop at the Old Navy next door instead of returning to Ross.

This store in New Orleans was overcrowded the fire dept should have been called the line stretched from the front all the way to the back wall shameful

I like this Ross compared to others I've been to. Everyone working is usually friendly and helpful. It's still Ross so I guess you can't expect stellar service. The girls arent exactly enthusiastic but the low prices and good selection make up for it.

Far better selection than they had when they first opened! I'm glad I gave them a 2nd shot. One of the cleaner Ross' in the area too.. fairly well organised.   I went with a friend to take a look at the offerings and see if they had any options for a Christmas party, and lo and behold, I found exactly what I was looking for!    I ended up buying far more than I intended, but I'm certainly not upset that I did! I got basically a whole holiday wardrobe for less than $100.00.
I like this place and I found my new luggage to use when I go back home. My wife loves this place and bought to many things to me carry.

Very empty store. Staff non-existent. Products are jumbled together and is basically a mess. I realize this is a discount store, but I've been to other Ross stores that are clean, neat and merchandised nicely.  One cash register open, Friday morning, and there were 15 people in line. What little staff walked by, took one look at the line and took off. The cashier soldiered on, but looked pretty irritated.   Not worth the stop.

It did feel a little empty when I walked in today.  But after my horrible experience at Kohl's, I felt down right pampered here. I find everything I wanted and then some.  The only reason for four stars rather than five is that there wasn't a lot of inventory.

I really like getting sheets, kitchen, and bathroom stuff here. They also have some great decorating things that are great, especially if you are on a budget like me. The clothes are cute and trendy but there aren't many choices in the larger sizes. Overall pretty great!
Always a little something for everyone. Great clearance prices and popular brands my kids love.

The selection here was okay. I don't know what it is about the Ross stores in town; they're all pretty ghetto and have poor to okay selections. Sigh.. but I can't help to go back in hopes of scoring a good deal. There's seriously something wrong with me.. like masochism. lol

One of my favorite shopping locations..I love Ross and this location is very large and clean..tons of great selections..I enjoy this location the best...I usually spend well over a $100 every visit...but definitely worth it..great bargains

Nice place to shop for decent clothing. I even find stuff i can wear to work for less than 10 dollars a piece. But, you will need to have the time, energy and patience of going through all those clothes because most times they are not so organized. It is not unusual that you will find an XS or XL in the medium section.

Beware upon entry to the parking lot, this is one of the lots that has HUGE speed bumps! They are as tall as the sidewalk curbs.  Now onto the store. I was kindly greeted by security upon entry. The store was clean and there weren't a bunch of kids running around unsupervised which was nice. I was surprised by all of the empty spaces on the shelves though. They could have easily fit thousands of dollars more worth of merchandise and still not been cluttered feeling. Everything I stopped to look at just seemed to be lacking in selection with plenty of room to expand in many different areas. I guess management likes the minimalist style in this store.

Picked up some super cute gift bags here. The interior is lackluster and drab but it's exactly what you might expect from a thrift retailer. You'll find your regular stock of affordable clothing and home goods as well as trendy snacks.  I'm really disappointed with customer service here. The cashier couldn't find the price tag on my item so she called her manager for help. I volunteered to grab another similar item with a price tag but she declined. Instead they decided to charge some arbitrary price. I went back and grabbed the other item anyway to prove they were wrong so we had to go through the 10 minute hassle of the cashier refunding and recapturing my purchases. All of this could have been avoided if she would just let me walk two minutes to get a price tag.  Honestly, I'd recommend you just go to TJ Maxx next door. It's much cheerier and well laid out in there. You'll get the same types of clothes and even more selection of home goods.

I don't even know why this Ross has a men's department. I have been to several Ross locations and they had a decent selection. This Ross has nothing, at least that I like. The women's selection is large, my wife always walks out with a cart full but the men's section. NOT!!!!

Definitely need more cashiers. But when I go to any Ross store I kinda expect to wait in line.  I know that going in.  Seems to be like that in all there stores. But the prices are great so I will wait. I always seem to find some great finds at this location verses other locations.  I always stop  in when I'm in the area .

Ross is fantastic if you need to look glamorous on a budget. This store especially has a huge selection of dresses, and not just the kind your grandma wears (forgive me if she's a snazzy dresser).   Yesterday I found at least 5 dresses that I wanted to try on. Their dressing rooms are huge, so it's not difficult to find a stall. The most expensive dress I tried on in there was less than thirty dollars. I think that speaks for how affordable this place is.  I agree with Dianna about the organization being up to par. I am a shopper on a mission and usually know exactly what I want, so I'm very thankful for the way that Ross has their departments split up. "Supermarket Sweep" types would appreciate this place.  To sum it up, Ross has the prices of a flea market with out all of the dust and questionable history.

When I go here I always find a good deal especially in home decor and clothing.  This store is well kept for the most part. The employees are friendly except one woman at the dressing room who argued back and forth with a customer for trying to cut the line.   The area is safe and the store is in a good well lit location.   There is plenty of parking as there is a strip mall nearby located in a huge shopping complex called Cedarbrook Plaza with a Walmart, Dollar tree, Jomar, Modells, CLC bookstore, and grocery store! You can find pretty much anything you need near this Ross.  This is definitely the place to go for a good deal and other shopping needs.
Fui una vez y definitivamente necesita más inventario. Sólo lleva un año abierto...le daré tempo

This Ross is just odd.  Very organized and clean.  But it has so little in merchandise or variety that keeping things in line would be easy.  The folks here are friendly and seem to stay busy lining things up on those shelves.

Ross has amazing stuff and unbeatable prices. But I would skip this location and drive to another. The upper management doesn't seem to have a grip on their employees. How do I know? From the employees loudly chatting about how they hate their job, hate customers and would rather have any other job than their current one. Not only do they speak these things loudly but will gladly do it while you are checking out. Another reason- complete laziness. The place is dirty and out of order. Like you can't remove a hanger from an item for a customer? Say thank you? Nothing?! And asking for help is like pulling teeth, either you will hear cussing under heir breath while attempting to help or will get zero help. They literally throw your items (glass or not) in a bag, roll their eyes and yell in your face "NEXT CUSTOMER!!!"

So mad right now! I purchased an outfit for my baby girl, the clerk did not remove the security tag, and I didn't notice until I went to put it on my daughter. Ross on Kietzke lane in Reno, Nv has the worst customer service ever...Specifically an employee named Lupe... She has the rudest attitude and acts like your bothering her when she helps you... She should not be working with the public... She is loosing business for Ross.. I will never go there again...

Love Ross but this Ross would be way better if they employees that work there would be nicer and more courteous. Most of them rarely smile or acknowledge you. Also the lines are almost always very long there unless you go right when they open. On the plus side...this is one of the cleaner Rosses...

Maybe I'm spoiled by the Ross in Smyrna . It's clean.. Organized & fully stocked with low price items ! This location is exactly the opposite. I walked in & though it was spacious , it lacked product . I couldn't find an associate to assist me . I walked aisle from aisle ... I walked towards the front for help . I didn't find help... Just more ehhh mess .. All over the store .   I'm in the process of moving so I enjoy places like Ross or Tj Maxx for small decor . Upon coming to this location I figured it's an high volume area which means better product . I was sadly mistaken . I'll stick to the Smyrna location & more miles on my car ... Well worth it .

This location used to be very good, however it seams that the last few times i have went there the attendants at the dressing rooms have been rude in their mannerisms. This is becoming a big let down. It is a clean location and i agree the lines do get long and the other employees do not go to the other cash registers to help out. If you have been standing in line for 5-10 min then maybe they will go on. Just annoying.
Lots of empty shelves and clothing racks here...I prefer the Ross in Spanish Springs because it has so much stuff! I wish they had more stuff at this location.
One of my favorite stores. Great prices on name brand clothing. Always come out with a purchase. Nice home deccorations.

I love going to Ross for their clothes and great finds on housewares.  I have to say though that this Ross store in Sparks, NV has consistently had the rudest employees of any retail store I have ever been to. I can do without it.

Pretty decent considering it's Ross. Aisles weren't very crowded and there was space to move around. Best time to go is during the week mid morning--weekends will have you wanting to pull your hair out. It's centrally locates to where if you get hungry you can pop into a FF place or get yummy treats at checkout. Either way it's a win win

I'm always intrigued to see a Ross next to a TJMaxx or a Marshall's.  Ross is definitely the two's less attractive little sister.  The store is not as well stocked as the Marshall's next door, but you can still find some great bargains.    For me, today's visit was all about t-shirts and underwear.  I grabbed some AMAZING Jockey t-shirts retailing for $24 each for $5.99.  They feel like linen and love on my back.    It's a great little location and there's tons of parking.  Check the stock often, as it changes all the time.

They closed early on a wednesday night and not one person would even give us eye contact. I did call in and emailed them to let them know what the deal was.  We were not the only ones who saw this three to four others as well.  I did get a call back saying they would look into it. This is not the only Ross who has issues in Texas which is where I am from we have problems there too with employees just not caring.  The reason for my review is in hope they will get better management.  I think the store is a good idea but just not neat really and sorry management =(

Ross is the place where my son has scored some great shoe deals...Jordans!  He's happy so I'm happy!  I don't particularly care for Ross, I'm a TJMaxx chick!  Jewelry selection just doesn't compare!  Nor does the home section.  I always head for the kitchen, linens and towels area.  Few times have I purchased anything for myself or home from this location!  Staff greet you as you enter and I like that!  Store isn't cluttered, actually it's quite sparse.  I'm a neat freak BUT I love my overly stocked shelves at the Maxx!  I love choices and selections!  I've rarely seen any new items week to week here...is business that bad?  I know everyone has opinions and preferences and I am completely biased for the Maxx!  No slight to this store, though.  Staff are friendly and accommodating as they should be!  Check it out!
Horrible ! Shoes are everywhere in here . When you do find nice shoes they're beat up and look as if ppl wore them outside already .

Even for a Ross, and I usually like Ross, this store is an unpleasant mess.  Despite finding a small number of items in the tiny Men's section that might have been good buys, we left without making a purchase because of the extremely unfriendly dressing room staff. I got yelled at for crossing some kind of invisible line in the dressing area to show my wife an item we'd picked out. Then my wife got yelled at for entering the dressing area to see the fit on me.   "I don't make the rules, I don't make the rules" barks the attendant. Well, we'll take our business somewhere the staff don't treat customers like prisoners.
Live Ross as a store.  This Ross is my least of my favorites that I go to.  Not friendly staff and don't find as much at this location.  The Ross in Palm Harbor is much better.
Rediculous they have only 2 fitting rooms located at the front of store in these small made up rooms. Took 20 mins just to wait for a fitting room

Please hire more staff. You are losing customers as they don't want to wait in line 10 plus people while only 2 cashiers are working on a Sunday afternoon. Might want to train the Loss Prevention Associate on how to run a register. And the Associate Dorothy at this store, needs to be a bit more in tune to her surroundings. Definitely one the cleanest locations in the Reno area! The staff is very friendly and helpful. I find myself visiting this location quite frequently to look for some great deals!

This is a very bare-bones Ross. I hardly find anything I really want here and the shoe selection for men here is offensively small (and it's not much better for women either). This seems like the Ross that attempts to sell all of the crap that the other Ross locations have failed to rid themselves of.  Customer service is scanty and the place is disorganized and often filthy. Clothes are out of order and thrown all over the place (same goes with shoes)  and while it's very possible to unearth something you want to purchase, good luck taking less than 20 minutes to locate it.   Ross isn't somewhere you go to shop fro a wedding or take your kid to find a dress for winter formal or homecoming but a patron should still be allowed to set moderate expectations even for a discount store. I have shopped at several Ross stores in numerous cities over the years and this location is, by far, the worst one I have ever been to.   I like how they have a "Loss Prevention" unit, which could be the biggest waste of funds a company of Ross' stature. The guys who actually work security seem to stroll around as if they detest their job (can't blame them) or, on the flip-side, with a God complex because they have been given the opportunity to be a quasi security guard.   I mean, if I was a Loss Prevention agent and someone was running out of Ross with cheap, inexpensive clothing, do you really think I would chase them? Not a chance and I don't expect them too. I applaud Ross for giving these folks employment, but maybe if they paid better attention to the disorganization and filth in the store, I wouldn't have such an issue with shelling money out for door security at a store that should not require it in any way.   If want to go to Ross in the future, this would be a last resort location for me.

I love Ross but this location is horrible. The store is always a mess and there is never enough cashiers. I was there last Thursday. There was about 10+ people in line with one cashier. I love me some Ross! Nice items for less! They have a great selection of home decor/household items!! The wall art selection is fantastic! They normally have fashionable clothes and shoes for women. Also, you will find nice travel bags. You can certainly find unique items for gifts. The fitting rooms are spacious and usually in good condition. The bargains are also pretty good. Sometimes they seem to have periods were they aren't as stocked or filled with merchandise. Not sure why that is. The purses/handbags selection is hit or miss when it comes to style, price, and quality. However, I have seen some great brands. I also really like that this store's closing hour is later around 10:30ish! Overall, glad it's a neighborhood store!

This is a decent Ross. It's clean and the staff seem friendly. I usually go in for clothing and toys.   They have other items like shoes, pictures, kitchen utensils, and more. The Ross is in a convent location near shopping areas.   The changing rooms are large and roomy. There is enough to where you don't have to wait for someone to be done before going in.   The only down fall is when there is to many people checking out their line seems long.
Love this store, got a few summer dresses.    Nice staff and clean store.

Ross is hands down one of my favorite places to go. You have to understand when you go to Ross they may not have everything you need. This location is usually well stocked and clean and everyone is friendly. It's one of my favorite locations. As always, the prices are amazing compared to department store.
Great place to get s really good deal. I always find really nice name brand clothes at Ross. The people here are ok. There friend enough but the prices are always right which is mainly why I go.

Ross is a hit or miss kind of discount store, so you can't really be too disappointed when you don't find anything worth buying when you visit.  That said, I couldn't rate this place any higher than three stars because I strongly dislike the way the store is set up.  When you walk in, there's so much obvious security that really kills any kind of casual shopping vibe you might otherwise get.  It feels more like visiting a three time felon doing time in Leavenworth than a retail shopping experience.  Add to that the fact that this is one of the messier Ross stores I've been to, and it's decidedly not my first choice shopping venue.  I really do like discount retailers; I just wish this one had a better vibe and more organization.

It's Ross, what more could you say! Well this place you could say alot as they offer alot of selections on everything. I found a (Houston Texans Hat there for $9.99) when the original price on it is $35.99 so it does offer alot of savings as i will come here to a Ross location before i head over to the mall or any other department stores. I enjoy the warming atmosphere of Ross, The Staff is helpful, and very nice to all customers. I really have never had a bad experience at any of the locations in the Reno/Sparks area.
It never fails..everytime I go in to return something I walk out with something else...lol. They have a moderately okay selection, just depends on the day of the week.

IT ONLY TAKES ONE!  It only takes one good purchase from Ross to keep you coming back.  That is why despite poor reviews, customers continue to return.  I can always find something unexpected at Ross.    Last week it was a pair of leather gloves.  Now there are leather gloves and there are LEATHER gloves!  These were LEATHER gloves and they were beautiful.  I has been several years since I've owned a pair of leather gloves because I kept losing them and it was just difficult to get the perfect fit.  These gloves fit like they were custom designed for me and they did not interfere with my ability to wear my rings.  I was shocked because never in my life would I even think of looking at Ross for leather gloves.  At the time, I was looking at the hats.    I love the Polo thermal tees because they are undeniable quality and actually keep you warm.  I purchase them for my son and myself.    Tonight, I found the king of muffin pans.  A regular pan makes 12 standard muffins and this one makes 24.  It is the perfect pan for a muffin maven and will save me loads of time.  I also scored a really nice pair of Columbia socks which are extremely comfortable and well cushioned.    This store was a bit messy from the holiday rush but not near as bad as a different location I visited a couple of days ago.  The registers were well staffed and our wait was minimal.   Tonight was a good night!

Friendly staff.  Clean store.   Finding stuff is hit or miss - like any store in this genre.  Good location/easy to access from main road.  Ample parking.  Lots of other stores nearby for other shopping needs.  They take Apple Pay at the registers, which is really convenient.  Make sure you save your receipt if you need to make a return, and don't take the tags off the clothes!

Sometimes I can find really awesome stuff here but this particular location doesn't have good inventory. I've been here numerous times and almost every time, we don't find anything good.
